objectDesc.p: Palm-leaf manuscript. 44 leaves in Balinese script. Containing 119 vratas.

colophon.quote: tәhәr aṅupavāsa, sadina sarātri, ikaṅ pupula mvaṅ sәkar sataman, tәhәr vinaveṅ paturvan pinajaṅ pajaṅan, mәne riṅ ḍavuh ro, tәkaniṅ ḍavuh, 7, aṅarәpakәna labahan sәga pitā, ivak iṭik ginoreṅ, saha sasahur, lontar druven, padanda gәḍe madhe sāri, riṅ griya sindhu timur.

objectDesc.p: Palm-leaf manuscript. 14 leaves in Balinese script. Containing 70 vratas.

colophon.quote: i śaka, 1722. vai, ka, vr̥, vāra marakih, praṭipāda riṅ śukla pakṣa, asuji māsa, rah, 2, tǝṅgǝk, 2. i rika divasanya, pūrṇa linikhita.

objectDesc.p: Palm-leaf manuscript. 51 leaves in Balinese script. Date: Thursday Kalivon, Vuku Marakih, first of a lunar fortnight in the bright half of the lunar month, third month or around September-October, unit 2, tens 2, 1722 Śaka or 1800 AD. Containing 339 vratas.

colophon.quote: iti panarima brata, ina lontar sakiṅ, griya śveta, lombok. sane nәdunin, i ñoman dәgәṅ, sakiṅ bañjar kuvum, ababi, abaṅ, karaṅasәm. puput sinurat. kāla dina, a, u, vāra variga, śaśih jyeṣṭa, i śaka, 1921.

objectDesc.p: Palm-leaf manuscript. 51 leaves in Balinese script. Tuesday Umanis, Vara Variga, eleventh month around Mei-June, 1921 Śaka or 1999 AD. Containing 132 vratas.

colophon.quote: iki saṅ hyaṅ vidyotkranti yeniṅ vuvusәn. druven pakultas śāstra udayana.

objectDesc.p: Palm-leaf manuscript. 26 leaves in Balinese script. Containing 109 vratas.

div.head: The Right Behavior in Performing the Observances
div.ab: nihan parikramaniṅpanarimatiṅkahiṅ panarima brata, yan kita mabrata, malәkasa brata hayva pati-pati, yan duruṅvuruṅ amvit amita iṅiri saṅ asәḍahan brata, hyaṅriṅ hyaṅ kaki citragopta, nini citragopta, tarimanənri tarimanәn iṅ sumur, caruca, sәḍah putih hijo, ma, pukulun kaki citragopta, nini citragopta, iṅsun amvit abrata, pukulunbrata pukulun dulurәn iṅsun abrata, katәkana sapinakṣanpinakṣansapinokṣәn iṅsun, yan asalahaṣanpah abratabrata, asalahata asalaha riṅ saṅsaṅ hyaṅ asәḍahan brata, sabratanta maṅkana. mvah sisigiṅsisiṅ abrata, kaṅ rahayu tәmən, ambulu, pha, sugih mās, sisigsig kayən,hayәn pha, bahuputra, sisig vaṅkal, pha, sugih pari, sisig lampәni, pha, labdhavaravasiteṅ kita. samavor samavor samanteṅ kvehnya, yogyayoga yoya kayatnākәnakayatna tәmən.

div.head: Holy Scripture on the Observances
div.ab: nihan saṅ hyaṅ tattva brata, kayatnākәna de saṅ amet kasiddhan, kasiddhaniṅ brata, tan pāvak tattvanira, saṅ hyaṅ dharma, rajəg turus[,] tattvanikatattvanira, apan pinakāvak balәbəd, lavanlavan ta tattvaniṅtattva brata, mvaṅ aṅlәpasakənmaṅlәpasakәnmaṅlәpasa kasiddhyan,kasiddhan sira kady aṅgāniṅ avak kiva tәṅən, maṅkana saṅ hyaṅ tattva brata mvaṅ tapa, mataṅnyanmataṅyanmataṅya lәkasakәnalәpasakәna de nirade saṅ amet hayu, anom alәkasalәkasa anom amaṅggihkapaṅgihmamaṅgih phalaniṅ brata, nora dadi yan tantan ginave, nora ṅalap titahiṅtitahniṅtitāniṅtitahiṅ ṅalap titahiṅ atitah,atah kady aṅgāniṅ haḍaṅaṅәḍaṅ esuk,aṅesuk esuk amaṅan, havan haḍaṅaṅәḍaṅ, havan amaṅan, yan iṅyan soresory haḍaṅ, soresory amaṅanmaṅan, yan tannora paḍaṅ tan pamaṅan, saolahsapolah-saolihsapolih, maṅkana kramanya, apan hala hayuniṅhayu pagave katәmu, mataṅnyan larisakәna pagave hayu, mijil sakeṅsaṅke tattva tapa brata.brata, ṅa

div.head: The Detailed Enumeration of the Observances
div.ab: nihan pariñciniṅ brata, kavruhakәna.

hana brata mәgat rasa, ṅa, yankramanya, yan satәṅahvusyan huvus amaṅan, suməṅkāṅinaṅpumәṅka aṅinaṅ, apәnəd tan paṅucappahupa, vus aṅinaṅ, malih amaṅan, satahun samayanya, bhaṭārī umā hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ mam̐ umāyaiumāyeumāya namaḥ, pamit, pha, tan pәgat sihniṅ malaky arabi,amarami mvaṅ samantasarvakita katvaṅaniṅ janmasamaṅkana paḍa sih.sihnya

hana brata amaṅanmaṅanmaṅana sәga slaṅgiṅgiṅgihgaṅgi, ṅa, satahun pituṅ lek samayanya, bhaṭārī vastu hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ vastu devyaidevyedevaya namaḥ, pamit, pha, tan pәgatpәgatan sihniṅ malaky arabiamarabi, ṅunivehkunaṅ veh sihniṅnikaṅniṅ samanta janmasama janmajanma kabeh paḍāsih avәlaspaḍa vәlas asisihpadhāvlas ikabeh iriiti
kita.

hana brata bhūmipattrambumipatrāabhumipatra, ṅa, yan amaṅan tan paharyantan payyan, aṅlak iaṅlaṅkiriṅri lәmah, hyaṅ vaiśravaṇaveśrāvaṇaśraivaṇa hyaṅnya, satahun pituṅ lek samayanya, ma, om̐ śrīśram̐śam̐si vaiśravaṇāyaveśravaṇāya namaḥ, pamit, pha, sugih lәmah, sīma, janānurāga kita ri saṅ prabhu mvaṅ ri saṅbhūmi viku.

hana brata amaṅan tan kasurupan saṅ hyaṅ śiva raditya, tigaṅ tahun samayanya, bhaṭāra śiva hyaṅniṅhyaṅiṅ brata, pha, apaḍaṅ kaṅ hati, prāṇa aṅən-aṅənta, ekasādhya, ma, om̐ mam̐ śivāya namaḥ, yan ahyas. hana brata amaṅan tan kasurupan...yan, ahyas

hana brata yan amaṅan anūtakǝnnutakәn vulan, lvirnyaṅa, taṅgal pisan1, sakәpǝl, yan iṅ avuvuh taṅgal, avuvuh sakәpǝl yan taṅgal, 2, rva kәpәl _ _ _ _ yan avuvuh taṅgalnya, avuvu sakәpәl,, makahiṅanmakahina lima vәlas kәpǝl, yan iṅriṅ pūrṇama, apan atambǝh sakǝpǝl irikaṅ sarahinariṅ, kunaṅkunәṅ riirikaṅ paṅlvaṅpaṅlvaṅa, lvaṅana ta ya sakәpǝlloṅana saka sakәpәl, naṅkǝn rahina, avәkasan aṅupavaśa yan iṅyan tilǝm, tәluṅ lek samayanyatigaṅ ulan divasanya , bhaṭāra indrabhaṭārendraida bhaṭāra indra hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ surendrāya namaḥ, pamit, pha, mantuk iṅ pada bhaṭāra śiva, sasarnya majanma riṅ ratu prajñan, mvaṅ viku bahuśiṣya kita.
hana brata yan amaṅan anūtakǝn vulan ... śiṣya təka; in P the title of the brata, mantra, and result is same with other witnesses, but tend to different in the technique to perform the observance. This is the complete passage of the ms P. "hana brata hañutakәn hulan·, yan amaṅan taṅgal hapisan·, sakәpәl·, taṅ, 2, rvaṅ kәpәl·, muṅgah sakәpәl· sadinā, tәkāniṅ taṅgal·, piṅ, 14, pūrnama hamr̥ti, yan paṅloṅ hapisan·, piṅ, 14, sinuddhana sakәpәl·, tәkaniṅ til̥m hamr̥ti, tigaṅ lek· ṣamayanya, bhaṭārendra hyaṅnya, ma, Ōm̐ surendra ya namaḥ, pamit·. phalanya mantuk iṅ bhaṭāra śivā, sasarnya mañjanmā riṅ ratu, mvaṅ riṅ vikva bhavu siṣyā kitā."

pūrṇamaniṅ kasa, saṅ hyaṅ amūrva bhuvana, pinakabapa, asihasi ririṅpinakeṅ hulun.
pūrṇamaniṅ karo, saṅ hyaṅ madhu sudhana, pinakababu, asih ririṅ pinakeṅhulun asih ri pinakeṅhulun, listuhayu paripūrṇa dr̥̥man keḍәp puruṣa viśeṣa prajñan vicakṣaṇa, sukha sugih.
pūrṇamaniṅ katiga, saṅ hyaṅ madhu kusuma, pinakāvakpinakiṅ i ṅhulun lituhayulistvayulistvā paripūrṇa, drәman keḍәp puruṣa viśeṣa, prajñanpragan vicakṣaṇa, sukha sugih.
pūrṇamaniṅ kapat, saṅ hyaṅ asmara pinakalaki ni ṅhulun, apәkikapәkik śakti prajurit vicakṣaṇa, puruṣa viśeṣa, prajñan sukha sugih jayeṅ śatru, asih pinakeṅhulun.
pūrṇamaniṅ kalima, saṅ hyaṅ manobhava, pinakasānak pinakaanak i ṅhulun, panǝṅgǝk lanaṅ, apәkik prajurit, asih pinakeṅasih pinakeṅhulun.
purṇamaniṅ kanǝm, saṅ hyaṅsaṅ atanuantanu, pinakasānak i ṅhulun lanaṅ, paṅgulu, sukha sugih, asihasih riṅasih ri pinakeṅhulun.
purṇamaniṅ kapitu, saṅ hyaṅ kāma jaya, pinakasānak i ṅhulun lanaṅ panәṅah, asihasih ri pinakeṅhulun.
pūrṇamaniṅ kavolu, saṅ hyaṅ kāma ratih pinakasānak i ṅhulun lanaṅ vuruju, sukha sugih asih ririṅ pinakeṅhulun.
pūrṇamaniṅ kasaṅa, saṅ hyaṅ kumara, pinakasānakpinakakṣana, duk i ṅhulun apaṅantenapapaṅanten pinasәlaṅinasәlaṅ.
pūrṇamaniṅ kasapuluh, saṅ hyaṅ amadhapa, samana duk i ṅhulun abobot.
pūrṇamaniṅ jyeṣṭā, saṅ hyaṅ kumara, pinakaanakpinakasanak lanaṅ pambayun, apәkik prajurit, hasihiṅasih riasih riṅ pinakeṅhulun, puruṣa viśeṣa, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, jayeṅ śatru, ahiḍǝp pinakeṅhulun.
pūrṇamaniṅ aṣādha, saṅ hyaṅ komari, pinakaanak vadon paṅgulupaṅgugulu, lituhayulistvayulistuhayu paripūrṇa, drәman keḍәp, puruṣa viśeṣā, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, ahiḍәp pinakeṅhulun.

hana brata tri ... sukha magə̄ṅ

hana brata, trisandhyāatri ndhya, ṅa, madyus piṅ tiga sarahinapiṅ tiga dyus iṅ rahinapiṅ tiga adyus sarahina, mvaṅ riṅ vәṅimviṅi kulәmmvaṅ riṅ, vusiṅ adyus asusurahuvusniṅ adyus masisigvuniṅ adyus, asisig, masipatamasipat, mañurat, pituṅ lek samayanya, pha, mulihiṅmulih mari kendranmulih riṅ kendran kendran, sasarnya mandadimanja_ _ _ vvaṅriṅ vvaṅ lituhayulistuhayu paripūrṇa prajñanprajña ya.
hana brata, trisandhya ... paripūrṇa prajñan
in 3.54 in 3.96 in 3.53

hana brata, kakaracankraca adyus, ṅa, adyus sarahina vәṅi, lǝṅa sipatnyacipatnya, pha, svarga mantuk riṅ kendranmantuk riṅ svarga riṅ kendran, majanmamañjanma vicakṣaṇa anulus, tur anom apәkikapәkik anvam kalah alatan pavicara.
hana brata, kraca ... kala hāla
in 3.97 in III………….

hana brata, amaṅan sarvamǝntah, bhagavān aṅgaṣṭi hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, dadi deva, sasarnya dadi ratu, kinasihaniṅ hyaṅ, prajurit aṅalahakǝn śatru kabeh, norāna maḍanana, tan kәna seh abrata.
hana brata, amaṅan... kәna seh abrata
in 3.98

hana brata aśuci lakṣaṇa, ṅa, tan pamaṅan yan duruṅ ararahup, alǝlәṅaalәṅha, pha, apәkik kerәṅan, saparipolihiṅ abrata, lәvǝsiṅlәvas rambut, asәḍǝpiṅ paṅūcap, mvaṅ rūpā.
hana brata haśuci ... mvaṅ rūpā
in 3.99 in 3.71

hana brata, nuci lakṣaṇa, ṅa, amaṅan ahes karuhun, pha, kerәṅan saparipolahta, alit arampiṅ, drәman alaki.
hana brata, nuci lakṣaṇa... drәmaan alaki
in 3.100

hana brata, mavastra śuddha malasuddha mala vastranya, mantranyaiti mantranya, ma, om̐ śuddha pāpa, śuddha mala, 3, śuddha śuddha pinariśuddha, śuddha śuddha pinarivastuŌm. phalanya, hilaṅ malā patakā, pāpa kleśantakaleśantakleśan, samayanya kaṅ bratasamayaniṅ brata, tigaṅ daśa dina30, dina, anambut riṅ tilǝmmanaṅgap riṅ tilәm, asalah riṅ tilǝm, asalah brata, sah sәkar rvaniṅ śuddha malaśuddha mala, pәtekakәna rvanya, mañomponi petaṅan mantranyamacaru śuci saḍanḍanan.
hana brata, mavastra ... petaṅan mantranya
in 3.101 in 3.130

hana bratabrata andaka rūpa, ṅa, yan taṅgal piṅ, 1apisan, taṅgal piṅ, 2pindo, taṅgal piṅ, 3piṅ tәlu, akambǝn śuddha mala, avastraastra saci, yan vus alabahanahabahan, pha, rūpanta lañjartan kasoran rūpanta, apәkik paripūrṇa, yan lanaṅ abrata, kalamar deniṅ strīistri yan strīistri kalamar deniṅ kakuṅ, andaka rūpa haraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, yan ... brata maṅkana
in 3.102 in 3.126

hana brata malāhāra, ṅa, yan amaṅan maṅgis, duryan, sakalviriṅ vovohan, tigaṅ lek samayanya, pha, mantuk mariṅ svarga bhaṭāra guru, mvaṅ bhaṭāra saḍāśiva, sasarnya majanma riṅ vvaṅ sugih sujana.
hana brata malahāra ... sugih sujanā
in 3.103

hana brata ṅinaṅ suruh tәmu ros, jambe taṅ vәnaṅ tampakiṅ ladiṅ, ginitik, suruh lǝmbaran, apuh bubuk, pha, tәguh tan pakәmitan, tur keḍәp.
hana brata ṅinaṅ ... tur keḍǝp
in 3.104

hana brata, tan pamaṅan jambe tan sinigarsinigi deniṅriṅ ladiṅ, pha, tan tǝtǝsmarasa nontәkәs deniṅ sarvalaṇḍǝplalaṇḍәpsarvalalaṇḍәp, jaya ri yuddha tan kevǝhanjaya riṅ baya, mvaṅ akveh asi, saṅ hyaṅ kālajaya riṅ yuddha tan kevәh.
hana brata, tan ... tan kevǝhan
in 3.77 in 3.105 in 3.93

hana brata, maharen vatu, deniṅ abrata, tәluṅ tahun, pha, tәguh bhujabhujana kulit, tur kәlar.
hana brata, maharen ... tur kәlar
in 3.106

hana brata, maṅan sakәpәlǝl, lavasnya pituṅ vәṅi, pha, kinasihaniṅ rāt kita.
hana brata, maṅan ... rāt kita
in 3.107

hana brata maṅan roṅ kәpǝl, lamanya pituṅ vәṅi, pha, guṇa tan kevǝhan.
hana brata maṅan ... tan kevǝhan
in 3.108

hana brata, maṅanamaṅan tigaṅ kәpǝl, tigaṅ vәṅi lavasnya, pha, kinasihan deniṅ rāt, imbuh imbuh tan paṅloṅimba imbuhan pahloṅ.
hana brata, maṅan ... tan paṅloṅ
in 3.109 in 3.104

hana brata trisamaya, ṅa, amaṅan sәga tigaṅ kәpǝl, salek samayanya, saṅ hyaṅ tiga maveh brata, pha, kinasihaniṅ paṇḍita, guṇamvaṅ guṇa mantra siddhi.
hana brata tri... mantra sidḍi
in 3.110 in 3.81

hana brata, trisamayatrisamana, ṅa, amaṅan tigaṅ kәpǝl, sarahina, tigaṅ tahun samayanya, pha, mantuk iṅ padasvarga bhaṭāra viṣṇu, sasarnya mañjanmamaṅjanma riṅ vvaṅ lituhayulistvayu paripūrṇa, sukha magə̄ṅ.
hana brata, tri ... sukha magə̄ṅ
in 3.111 in 3.50

hana brata, ekabhaktaekabhakti, ṅa, amaṅan sakәpǝlamaṅan sakәpәl tәkaniṅ sari-sari, pituṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, prih meṅgal katәmu.
hana brata, Eka ... meṅgal katmu
in 3.112 in 3.32

hana brata, amaṅanmaṅan pituṅ kәpǝl, pituṅ dina lavasnya, bhaṭāra gaṇa veh brata, pha kinasihan deniṅ rāt kabehgaṇa katapakanya
hana brata, maṅan ... ghaṇa katapākanya
in 3.113 in 3.103

hana brata, amaṅan ro vәlas kǝpǝl, pha, siddhakārya, amukti ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, amaṅan... brata maṅkana
in 3.114

hana brata, amaṅan kupat kǝpǝt, mevaka sarvaśuci, 3, vәṅi divasanya, aṅalakimadā, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ iśvara sira turun brata, ya minakarūpa sira, pinakaśvaraniṅ aṅiduṅ, manisiṅ panutukan, brahmāṇi asuṅ rontal, pha, labdhavara riṅ rāt, makveh asih iri kita.
hana brata, amaṅan ... hasihi ri kitthā
in 3.115

hana brata, amaṅan kupat kǝpǝl, tuṅgal ivaknya sarvaśuci, tigaṅ vәṅi divasanya, aṅali pada, ṅa, hyaṅ iśvara turun abrata, pha, ya pinakarūpa, pinakaśvaraniṅ aṅiduṅ, manisiṅ paṅūcap.
hana brata, amaṅan ... manisiṅ paṅucap
in 3.116

hana brata, amaṅan kupat kǝpǝl, pituṅ viji, amaṅan rahina, esuk sore , tәṅah ṅve, titiga, sore, roro, ivaknya isiniṅ loh, salek lavasnya, pha, rinakṣa deniṅ ratu, kinasihan deniṅ voṅ sukha tǝmbe.
hana brata, amaṅan ... sukha tǝmbe
in 3.117

hana brata, amaṅan sakәpǝl, tatkālaniṅtatəkalaniṅ taḍahan sapulukan, pituṅ vәṅi lavasan ika, pha, kinasihaniṅ rāt, mvaṅ jana nurāga, ekaki ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, amaṅan... brata maṅkana
in 3.118

hana brata, aturu aṅadǝg, sabhāgya yen aṅeka pāda pisan, pituṅ vәṅi samayanya, yen kita amaṅan sakәpǝl sarahina, yan aṅinum bañu sahĕlǝd, tәluṅ dina, tәluṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, sapocapan riṅ deva, byakta śakti tәkeṅ kamokṣan.
hana brata, atur ... tәkeṅ kamokṣan
in 3.119

hana brata, maṅan rvaṅ kәpǝl, pituṅ vәṅi lavasanya, guṇa mogha dataṅ, tan kevuhan, phalanya, anidrā ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, maṅan ... brata maṅkana
in 3.120

hana brata maṅan tigaṅ kәpǝl, trimasa, tiga vәṅi lavasanya, pha, kinasihaniṅ rāt, trisamaya ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata maṅan ... brata maṅkāna
in 3.121

hana brata, amañcagǝma, ṅa, amaṅan sәga limaṅ kәpǝl sari sari, limaṅ leklek paveh samayanya, pha, kinasihan deniṅ samantakinasihaniṅ sama janma, kāṣṭaguṇankaśruguṇakasrugun, kavīryavan, kasubhāgyan sugih siddhimantra.
hana brata, amañca ... siddhi mantra
in 3.122 in 3.82

hana brata, maṅan pituṅ kәpǝl, sapta latri lavasanya, guṇa moga ḍatәṅ, sarvaviṣyasarvaviṣa tan kataman kita, yeka phalanya, catur mukha ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, maṅan ... brata maṅkana
in 3.123

hana brata, maṅanamaṅan pituṅ kәpǝlkәpәl, ṅakәpәl sarahina, pataṅ lekpәtaṅ lek samayanya, pha, amuktimukti sukha riṅ dlāhariṅ dlāhantakiteṅ dlāhariṅ dlānta.
hana brata, amaṅan ... riṅ dlāha
in 3.55 in 3.124 in 3.54 in 3.63, 3.65

hana brata, amaṅan saṅaṅ kәpǝl, naṅkәn pūrṇama, mrtiāhāramrәtihara, ṅa, moliha tigaṅ kasaṅa, pha, mantuk mariṅ svarga bhaṭāra indra, sasarnya mañjanma mariṅ vvaṅ lituhayulistvayu paripūrṇa, sugih saṅkan rare.
hana brata, amaṅan ... saṅkan rare
in 3.125

hana brata maṅan sadaśa kәpǝl, taḍah pisan, sadaśa lek lavasanya, pha, salvirniṅ lara rogha tan tame kita, aṅadhava ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata maṅan ... brata maṅkana
in 3.126

hana brata, aṅapitu, ṅa, amaṅan pituṅ kәpǝl, moliha tigaṅ kapitu, pha, mantuk riṅ bhaṭāra brahmā, sasarnya majanma riṅ vvaṅ sugih saṅkan rare, lituhayulistvayu paripūrṇa.
hana brata, aṅapitu ... listvayu paripūrṇa
in 3.127

hana brata, naṅkǝn radite umanismanis, amaṅan sǝga sakәpǝlsakәpәl, tәluṅ radite Umanistәka roṅ radite amaṅan roṅ kәpәl, tәka tәluṅ radite amaṅan tigaṅ kәpәl, pha, tis manak anak, tәrus tumus təkaniṅ anak putu buyut, sukha sugih tan kabañcanakavicara.
hana brata, naṅkǝn ... tan kabañcana
in 3.128 in 3.100

hana brata añәkul bañu, ṅa, kramanya, amaṅan sәga sakәpǝl, sadina, beñjaṅanya rvaṅ kәpǝl, puhanannyavuvananya, 3, kәpǝl, tәlunanya malabahan, mantraniṅ amaṅanma om̐ nirogha, nirpāpa, nirmala, niṅ bapebunirbape bu lukar mulih jati nityaśa. amaṅan tan pahuyah, tan paivak, kneṅ dyus kevala, tan kәneṅ lisah, tan kǝneṅ vәḍak, tan paṅinum tuvak, tan paṅinaṅtan paṅinum salvir amuroni, tan aṅinaṅ sәrәh, tan paturu riṅ rahinatan paturu rahina, tan kabañcaran, pha, hilaṅ salviriṅ lararara roga.
hana brata añәkul ... lara roga
in 3.129 in 3.58

manih brata añәkulñәkul bañu, riṅ cәkokiṅ taṅan paṅan sәga sakәpǝl, toya sacәkokiṅ taṅan, tigaṅ dina samayanya, sabhāgya, 5, dina, ma, kәbas valuya jāti. pha, nirlara vighna.
manih brata ñәkul ... nirlara vighna
in 3.130

hana brata añәkulñәkul bañu, śa, vaḍahnyavaḍah daḍasar cәmǝṅ, ma, om̐ hana boloṅ tan pahudǝranpahederan, ana boloṅ tan pamala, nirvighna nirtaṅisnirvighnaniṅ taṅis, om̐ śrī srīya namaḥ svāhā, om̐ mam̐ya namaḥ svāhā. amita ri saṅ asәḍahan brata, riṅri saṅgar, ma, om̐ mam̐ iśvarāya namaḥ svāha.
hana brata ñәkul bañu ... namaḥ svāhā
in 3.131 in 3.60 in 3.67

hana brata añәkul bañu, ṅa, amaṅan sacalovakaniṅ taṅan, pituṅ vәṅi samayanya, nasi kalavan bañu, ma, om̐ nirroga, nirpāpa nirbapebu, lukǝṅ mulih jatinyasah, lukar sapāpaniṅ śarīra, mvaṅ pāpaniṅ bapebu.
hana bratañkul bañu ... pāpaniṅ bapebu
in 3.132 in 3.69

hana brata ñәkul bañu, mañjiṅ lima, ṅa, puluṅ kaṅ sәkul, 1, inumi bañu, 1, malih amuluṅ sәkul, 1, inumi bañu, piṅ tәlu hiṅane, raris amaṅan, sakarәpiṅ amaṅan vәnaṅ, vusaniṅ amaṅan, ṅinum bañu, raris akәmuh avajik, aṅinaṅ, mariṅ vĕtǝṅi voṅ, samaṅkana uga kramanya, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, uttama lavasnya satahun, ma, om̐ hana boloṅ tan pamala, hana boloṅ tan paudǝranpaundǝran, nirvighna nirtaṅis nirroga, nirupadrava, siṅniṅ mala malina, pha, hilaṅ sarvamalaniṅ śarīranta, kinasihan deniṅ saṅ prabhu, mvaṅ deva sih iri kita.
hana brata ñәkul ... iri kita
in 3.60 in 3.133

hana bratamantraniṅmamantrabrata añәkul bañuanәkulñәkulmañәkul, ma, saṅ drәmba moha, sirasih maṅanaamaṅana riṅ pasarmariṅ pajagalanriṅ pajagalan, saṅ kāla viṣaya, sirasaṅ kāl viṣaya sira amaṅana riṅ pasar maṅana mariṅ pajudenamaṅan riṅ pajuden, saṅ kāla ṅaḍaṅ, sira maṅanaama ṅanaamaṅana riṅmariṅ dalan guṅ, saṅ kāla katuṅkәtuṅ, sira maṅanaamaṅanamaṅana riṅ pajagalanmariṅ pasarpasar aguṅriṅ pajuden, vusanira amaṅanri uvus adyusa rumuhunri vuvus sira amaṅan aṅinumvus sira amaṅan, muliha mariṅ rāga valunaniṅ hulunmakaramasa, masisiga, marvi-rvihansira muliha mariṅ rāga valunakveṅ hulunmuliha sira riṅ rāga valuniṅ hulun, rovaṅaniṅ hulun makārya hayurovaṅaniṅ hulun hamaṅun hayurovaṅaniṅ hulun amaṅan kārya hayu, om̐ siddhir astu.
hana brata ñĕkul ... om̐ sidḍir astu.
in 3.61 in 3.134 in 3.57 in 3.68

hana brata tan paṅinum bañu, tatkālaniṅ amaṅan, yan kasәrәtankaśrәḍәp, atәlasan pisan kita maṅan, pituṅ lek samayanya, pha, tan asǝrәt kaṅ sinadyanta, mogha mrih iri kita.
hana brata tan ... mrih iri kita
in 3.135

hana brata tan paṅinum bañu, satahun divasanya, pha, śakti, hyaṅ padma hyaṅniṅ brata.
hana brata tan ... hyaṅniṅ brata
in 3.136

hana brata amaṅan avaḍah goḍoṅ, sinaṅga riṅ taṅan kiva, tan pavuvuh, pha, kinasihan deniṅ rāt, vәkasan tan paṅinum bañu, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, siddha sādhya phalanya.
hana brata amaṅan ... sādhya phalanya
in 3.137

hana brata amaṅanmaṅan tan pembuhpaimbuh, pituṅ tahun samayanya, pha, bhoga gәṅ təkamagәṅ tinәmuntameṅgal katәmu.
hana brata amaṅan ... gə̄ṅ tәka
in 3.138 in 3.21 in 3.56, 3.57

hana brata, tan dady atambǝh, pituṅ vәṅi lavasanya, medhā prajā siddhakārya phalanya, aniraṅ ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, tan ... brata maṅkana.
in 3.139

hana brata tan pavuvuh, tan paṅinum bañu, lamun sampun aṅinaṅ, aṅinum bañu vәnaṅ, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, pha, prajurit kita.
hana brata tan ... prajurit kita
in 3.140

hana brata amaṅana ron, sinaṅga riṅ taṅan kiva tan patәḍa tan pavuvuh, tigaṅ vәṅi lavasnya, padma raṅkǝp, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ capuriṅ rāt sira turun abrata, pinakagulu jariji suku, tәhәr kinasihaniṅ rāt.
hana brata amaṅan aron ... kinasihaniṅ rāt
in 3.141

hana brata amaṅan tan pavuvuh, pituṅ vәṅi lavasnya, siddhakārya, kinasihaniṅ rāt phalanya.
hana brata amaṅan ... rāt phalanya
in 3.142

hana brata amaṅan papahpapa davun, sinaṅga riṅ taṅan kiva, tan patәḍa tan patambǝh, hyaṅ ekṣasaṇa turun abrata, pha, kinasihaniṅ rāt.
hana brata amaṅan ... kinasihaniṅ rāt
in 3.143

hana brata tan dady atambǝh, pituṅ vәṅi lavasanya, medhā prajā siddhakārya phalanya, aṅiraṅanira ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata tan... brata maṅkana
in 3.144
hana brata, yan amaṅan tan patәḍa tan patambǝh, pha, tan paśatru kita riṅ niṣkala.
hana brata mona, ṅa, yan amaṅan tan paṅucap, tigaṅ tahun samayanya, bhaṭāra rudra hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ rudrāya namaḥ, pamit, pha, kinatvaṅan deniṅ jagat, siddha saprayojanantasaprayojñānanta.
hana brata, maṅan amona, tan paṅinum bañu, vusiṅ amaṅan aṅinum bañu, aṅūcapakәna, pha, tan kәna gǝgǝriṅangәgәriə̄n, viśeṣa riṅ bhūmi, keḍәp kapintuhu, pituṅ śaśih divasanya.
hana brata, monāraka, tan paṅucap lamun amaṅan, tәluṅ tahun samayanya, bhaṭāra rudra hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, ginañjar deniṅ hyaṅ kabeh, guṇa təka.
hana brata, mona maṅan. mona nap. mona muris. mona susur. mona bhasma. mona napuh. mona ṅisiṅ.
div.p: kunaṅ mulihiṅ mona,
mona maṅan, pha, vicakṣaṇa dīrgha yuṣa kita.
mona nap, pha, kinasihan deniṅ rāt, prabhu viku.
mona bhasma, pha, mantuk iṅ bhaṭārī rātri, sasarnya majanma riṅ viku śakti.
mona napuh, pha, kinasihaniṅ paṇḍita, mvaṅ deva prabhu, rahayu riṅ pañjanmanta.
mona ṅisiṅ, pha, prih meṅgal katәmu, bahusiṣya kita.
mona sisig, pha, jaya kāryanta, prabha kiteṅ kamokṣan.
mona muris, pha, siddhakāryanta, pinrihta muna təka.

div.ab: hana brata, pañcamukha, ṅa, naṅkǝn kalivon amona sasore, aṅraṅkus brata kabeh, pha, amaṅgih sukha magә̄ṅ, majanma riṅ sugih sәkul amukti saṅkan rare, keḍәp deniṅ rāt kabeh.

hana brata ṅunir, ṅa, yan amaṅan sәkul kinuniran, lavasnya sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, bhaṭāra mahādeva hyaṅnya, pha, mulih mariṅ svarga bhaṭāra mahādeva, sasarnya mañjanma riṅ dam puvavaṅ, sugih dana hulun, labdhavara ri saṅ ahulun.
hana brata amaṅan kuñit, makalalab, amanah kañcana, ṅa, pha, sugih mās.

hana brata, aṅuniṅ, ṅa, sәkul kuniṅ juga pinaṅan, yan tan maṅkana, kunir juga makalalab, pituṅ tahun samayanya, bhaṭārī ratih hyaṅiṅ brata, pha, mantuk iṅ svarga bhaṭāra mahādeva, sasarnya mañjanma riṅ dam puvavaṅ śakti.
hana brata ṅuniṅ, ṅaṅuniṅ, kunir paṅan rumuhunpaṅan rumuhun, saleksavulan lavasnya, ma, om̐ niryāya namaḥ svāhānirya namaḥ svāhā.

app.note:
hana brata ṅuniṅ, ... namaḥ svāhā
in III.154 in III.76

div.ab: hana brata, ambhīma, ṅa, yan amaṅan mevaka uyah, satahun tigaṅ lek divasanya, bhaṭāra Iśvara hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ mam̐ iśvarāya namaḥ, pamit, pha, siṅ pinrih meṅgal katәmu, kinasihan de saṅ paṇḍita, mvaṅ deva bhūta sih iri kita.
hana brata ambhīmambhīma, ṅa, yan taṅgal, piṅ 12, riṅ kapitu, amatiāhāraamatihara, pha, sukha vr̥ddhi, tur siddhimantra, jayeṅ śatru, keḍәp kapintuhu deniṅ rat, amupu saprajāniṅ voṅ kabeh.

hana brata ambhīma, ṅa, yan amaṅan mevaka uyah, u, amaṅan putihiṅ taluh, bavaṅbaṅ pәtak, pa, amaṅan kәtan baṅ, bavaṅ baṅ, pva, amaṅan sәga kuniṅ, mevaka kuniṅiṅ taluh, va, amaṅan kәtan irәṅ, mevaka bakula, ka, amaṅan asәga amañca varṇa, mevaka salvirnya, pha, sugih mās salaka, mvaṅ vәsi
hana brata mona turu sumaṇḍah, tigaṅ lek samayanya, bhaṭāra viṣṇu hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ um̐ um̐ viṣṇuve namaḥ, pha, labdhavara kita, mandi sakәcapta.
hana brata turu sumaṇḍahsumaṇḍyah, ṅa, salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra śambhu maveh brata, pha, apәkik kayovanankevanan tejataja kula.

app.note:
hana brata turu ... taja kula
in III.159 in III.86

div.ab: hana brata, aṅumbhakarṇaumbhakarṇa, ṅa, yan aturu, miriṅ satahun, roṅ tahun samayanya, devāntara hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ devantarāya namaḥ, pamit, pha, putra vr̥ddhi, patikpamәtik vәnaṅ-vәnaṅ paḍamada sih sama vr̥ddhi.

hana brata, kumavaśa, ṅa, aṅupavāśa pituṅ kulǝmvәṅi tan kәneṅkәna riṅ turunidrā rahina vәṅiriṅ rahina vәṅi, pha, vīryavan, siddha sakāryantasakahyunta, tan pamaṅgih kevǝhsiddha kapaṅgih.
hana brata, kumavaśa ... pamaṅgih kevǝh
in III.161 in III.83

hana brata, niṅibu, ṅa, amaṅan sarvaibu, pataṅ lek divaśanya, pha, mulih riṅ svarga bhaṭāra rudra, sasarnya majanma riṅ kula, saṅ kumbhakarṇa, aturu tan paṅlihan, rahina vәṅi tur aṅupavāśa, pha, keḍәp saparipolahta.

hana brata, tan pamaṅanpaṅan tan paturu, saṅbrata saṅ hyaṅ tan kaviśeṣa,kaviśeṣan hyaṅnya, phaṅa, phalnya, svarga titisnya.
hana brata, tan ... svarga titisnya
in III.164 in III.113

hana brata, lәvih turu, ṅa, tan trәṣṇeṅ paṅān, bhaṭārī keśava hyaṅiṅ bratahyaṅnya, pha, mantuk riṅ svargasvargan bhaṭāra śiva, mañjanma ri kulaputra, luputiṅ lara vighna, subhaga anulus.
hana brata, lәvih ... subhaga anulus
in III.165 in III.116
hana brata, mopavāsa pituṅ rātri, atәhәr tan kәneṅ turu rahina vәṅi, bhaṭāra śīva hyaṅiṅ brata, ma, om̐ nāma śivāya, pamit, pha, vīryavanviyavan , pha, sakāryanta siddha, tәhәr siddhi.

hana brata ambīraambhirambira, ṅa, yan amaṅan mevakamevak uyah kevala, satahun tigaṅ lek samayanyalavasnya mvaṅ tigaṅ lek samayanya, bhaṭāra iśvara hyaṅnya,bhaṭāreśvara hyaṅnya ma, om̐ mam̐ iśvarāya namaḥ pha, siṅ prihprihsiṅ pinrih meṅgaleṅgal katәmu, kinasihiṅ rāt kita,tur kinasihan deniṅ rāt mvaṅ deva bhūta sih iri kitadeva bhūta sih iri kitatur kinasihan deniṅ deva bhūta.
hana brata ambira... iri kita
in III.167 in III.30 in III.13
hana brata aṅlavar, ṅa, tan pamaṅaniṅ uyahan, satahun divasanya, bhaṭāra śaṅkara hyaṅnya, pha, mulih riṅ kendran, sasarnya majanma riṅ lituhayulistvayu prajña kita.

hana brata, ṅlavar, ṅa, tan pamaṅan uyah, pat vulan pәtaṅ vәṅi samayanya, bhaṭāra śaṅkara hyaṅnya, pha, mantuk mariṅ kendran, sasarnya mañjanma lituhayu paripūrṇa.
hana brata, ṅlavar ... listuhayu paripūrṇa
in III.169 in III.81
hana brata, aṅupavāsa, ṅa, lamun amaṅan aṅgugut uyah arәṅ rumuhun, 3, tahun divasanya, bhaṭārī gaṅga hyaṅniṅ brata, ma, om̐ gaṅgāyaigaṅgāya nama svāhā, pha, saparipolahta kinerәṅan deniṅ jagat.

hana brata, maṅan tumpǝṅ mevakivak uyah harәṅ, bhaṭāra iśvara hyaṅnya, ya pinakarūpa, pinakaśvaraniṅ kiduṅ carita, pha, manisiṅ panutukan.
hana brata, maṅan ... manisiṅ panutukan
in III.171 quite similiar, but different in the technique and the result. Here is the P: hana brata maṅan tumpәṅ ivaknya huyah harәṅ, pәtaṅ tavun samayanya, kinasihan deniṅ padhanta janma
hana brata, amaṅan kǝmbaṅ, naṅkǝn, u, mevakivak uyah harәṅ, vusiṅ amaṅan, aṅinaṅ suruh pupucuk, aṅliṅga kǝmbaṅ, ṅa, pha, sukha sugih, rūpa aheṅ.
hana brata, amaṅan tan pauyah, pituṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, śaktinta ḍatәṅ, tәhәr kinatvaṅan deniṅ hyaṅ.
hana brata, amaṅan arasotih, ṅa, aḍahar uyah harәṅ pinakavulamminakavulam, lama pituṅ dina, ra nini paduka bhaṭārī sarasvatīśarasoti hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, prajñan.
nihan kr̥ta māsa, ṅa, hayuniṅ hulun, akāryasakārya hayu, makādi vatǝk abrata, nūt avarah,
div.p: śaśih ka, 1, taṅ, piṅ, 10, saṅ hyaṅ vīra kusuma devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan sarvabuṅkah, pha, sugih anom drәman avǝvәka ta sira.
śaśih, 2, taṅ, piṅ, 7, saṅ hyaṅ jaya kusuma devatanya, bratanya hayva maṅan sapi, pha, luputeṅ tuju tәluh tarañjana, drәman ahiven iven.
śaśih, 3, taṅ, piṅ, 9, saṅ hyaṅ naka devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan bavi, pha, tan katampǝkan gәriṅ aguṅ.
śaśih, 4, taṅ, piṅ, 15, saṅ hyaṅ asmara devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan sarvaroṇḍon, pha, dadi siṅ tinandur.
śaśih, 5, paṅloṅ, piṅ, 15, saṅ hyaṅ mahādeva devatanya, bratanya, hayva sǝhǝk yan aṅucap, hayva ṅǝmbannǝṅbaṅ boñcah, pha, drәman avǝvәka.
śaśih, 6, taṅ, piṅ, 8, saṅ hyaṅ atanu devatanya, bratanya, hayva aṅinǝp, riṅ paluluṅhān, pha, sugih tan kelaṅ elaṅan.
śaśih, 7, taṅ, piṅ, 13, saṅ hyaṅ manasija devatanya, bratanya, aṅraka, pha, sugih keḍәp kapaṅgih siṅ giṇa harṣa.
śaśih, 8, taṅ, piṅ, 2, saṅ hyaṅ anaṅgara devatanya, bratanya, hayva amaṅan paṭik vǝnaṅ suku pat, pha, sugih patik vǝnaṅ.
śaśih, 9, taṅ, piṅ, 6, saṅ hyaṅ ravi devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan asu, pha, apәkik raspati prajurit.
śaśih, 10, taṅ, piṅ, 4, saṅ hyaṅ brahmā devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan andǝlәṅ riṅ luhur, pha, kinasihaniṅ hyaṅ, mvaṅ voṅ mule akvehakeh asih iri kita.
śaśih, jyeṣṭa, taṅ, piṅ, 5, saṅ hyaṅ leka jaya devatanya, bratanya, aṅlampar ananapu, pha, keḍәp mandi sakәcapta.
śaśih, saddhā, taṅ, piṅ, 1, saṅ hyaṅ pisodharī devatanya, bratanya, hayva turu lavan strīistri, pha, keḍәp aomah-omah.
iya ṅitaṅ kariṅ vulan, kr̥ta masa haranya, den asthiti sira, keṅәtakәna hayvayva lupa.

div.ab: hana brata, saninigraha, ṅa, tan mamati aghni ri kālaniṅ tumpǝk kalivon, molahamoliha sapuluh tumpәk kalivon, kramanya amujatamumuja, ananapuh eṅ saṅgar, amvittāmvit anǝmbaha ri bhaṭāra śīvāditya, lviriṅ caru riṅ saṅgar, anapunar, arih, rәmbaṅ, tambo lagu akah araka, phala, kambaṅ vaṅi, burat vaṅi, lәṅa vaṅi, sәḍǝṅan ikṣu, dīpa, dhūpa, den asaṅkǝp, devadarv inasab, vīja, dhūpa, ika kahatur i bhaṭāra, ma, om̐ namo bhagavatye vaśūdevāya, sarvatuṣṭan, dadāsime, om̐ śrī gurubhyo namaḥ, devacarundādasi mahātrәpti svāhā.

tәlas ta ṅavaṅia ta kita, ma, om̐ sūrya putrāya namaḥ. samaṅkana taṅ brata lәkasakәna, hayva ta pramada riṅ brata, kunaṅ yan kālaṅan agriṅ, sakalviraniṅ aṅalaṅana, pinakavuruṅaniṅ brata, hayva pinakṣakǝn ikaṅ brata, kaliṅanya mvitana juga muvah, kunaṅ yan tan kalaṅana, anulus rahayu, pakṣakәna ika, pha, riṅ dlāhanta dadi ratu sukha vāhya katәmu, pinakāśraya deniṅ paḍanta ratu, keḍәp kapintuhu deniṅ rāt kabeh.

iti sāriniṅsani brata, kayatnakәna de saṅ ametmet hayu, ndan ika hayva malәtuh ikaṅ ambǝk, mataṅyan ika hayva mithyamiṣya buddhi, tātkalanta maṅanakǝn brata, apan yan tan karakṣa ikaṅ brata denta, maṅdadyakǝn vighnaniṅ śarīra, yan enak denta rumakṣa sarīra, makajñāna buddhi mahottama, malilaṅa ahniṅ nirāvaraṇa, tan pagәlәh-gәlәhpagәlә-gәlәh, tan karakәtan karṇa śūla, mvaṅ rajah tamah, ika ta maṅdadyakǝn svarga magәṅ, ṅuniveh jñāna viśeṣa, vruha ri kramanira sovaṅ-sovaṅ.

hana brata sabran umanismanis, ṅa, tan pamaṅan tampakiṅ apuy, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, sabran pahiṅ tan pamaṅan tampakiṅ aghni, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, sabran pon tan padus tan palәṅa, tan pararavup, tan pakәkәmuh, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, sabran vage, tan paturu gumuliṅ, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, sabran kalivon, tan paṅucap-ucap, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, pha, ginañjar deniṅ vatǝk devata kabeh, norana nūkr̥tani, tan hilaṅ takonakәna, drәventa tǝmbe.
nihan haji pabrata, yaniṅ taṅgal piṅ lima, anuju kalivon, paṅupavāśa,
div.p: esuknya riṅ umanismanis, amaṅan kupat pāṇḍava, 5, ivaknya kacaṅ, pha, dukiṅ alit duruṅ anәmu, yan vus agәṅ amaṅgih sukha sugih aguṅ dunya.
pa, amaṅan kupat syaṅ anti, 9, ivaknya komak, pha, tinuṅgu deniṅ rāma reṇa, aṅantos aputu abuyut, kinadhama deniṅ bapebu, kapti deniṅkaptini hulun.
pva, amaṅan kupat sidayu, 7, ivaknya sudhaṅ, pha, aṅapti listvayu, alit arampiṅ aṅlәlǝnte, tan amadhani, sukha sugih drәman baṅkit, pinarәkan pinakapahulunaniṅ maru.
va, amaṅan kupat sih tan pәgat, 4, ivaknya taluh, pha, aṅapti sukha sugih, drәman siddhi baṅkit, keḍәpiṅ alaki, tan kavaśa lakinta aṅluṅani, pinūji deniṅ matva, tanana ṅesǝm.
ka, anәḍa kupat gәnǝp, 8, ivaknya raraśmen, pha, aṅapti sukha sugih aguṅ vīrya, añjǝnǝṅ arddha nareśvarī, keḍәp aṅucap.

esuk riṅ umanismanis, anәḍa kupat siddha luṅguh, 10, ivaknya dagiṅ loh, sāgara dhanu, alas savah, dagiṅ pomahan, pha, aṅapti sukha sugih aguṅ vīrya, kinajrihan deniṅ śatru, kinadama deniṅ bala mvaṅ varga, pinarәkan deniṅ bala sabraṅsabran, tan kevaṅanivaṅ deniṅ bala, sami vatra tan anaṅsal, siddhi maṇḍi tan paṅucap, rәmrәm ikaṅ vvaṅ kabeh, riṅ panaṅkilan, tinaṅkiliṅ bala sakiṅ doh, abahan təka sakiṅ tan hana, sabran-sabran, yan vadon sinivi deniṅ maru, tan hana maḍani, sadera ṅrehakәna, vr̥ddhi putra, kinajrihan deniṅ santana, vīrya bhukti, embuh mañabuh, imbuh-imbuh tan paṅloṅ. sami danur daha.

div.ab:
hana brata nuṅku rāt, ṅa, kalivonka andhūmahamaduma. umanismanisU, madhuāhāramadhuhara, pahiṅpva, abhāyuāhāraabhayuharaambhayuhara, pvanpva, atoyāhāraatoyahara, vageva, aghniāhāraaghnihāra, pūrṇama, tīlәm, amatiāhāraamatihāra, piṅ rvana kabehpiṅrvanaka, ṅapiṅ rva nika, phaakabeh phalanyaika ta kabeh, pha,, amupusi brata kabehamupiṅ brata kabehamuvusi brata kabeh.
hana brata nuṅku ... brata kabeh
in III.56 in III.179 in III.64

hana brata, mañcavāramañcadara, ṅa, umanismanis amaṅanumaṅan sәga putih, pahiṅ amaṅan kәtanlakәtan baṅ, ponpvan amaṅan sәga kuniṅ, vage amaṅan kәtan irәṅ, kalivon amaṅan kәtan amañca varṇa. vetan amaṅan antǝlu putihnyasәga putih mvah antәlu putihnya, kidul sura, kulon antǝlu kuniṅkuniṅnya, lor bakakulbakatul, riṅ tәṅah śarasi baṅ hatiatih, pha, sukha sugih.
hana brata, mañcavara ... sukha sugih
in III.180 in III.80

hana brata, anūt saptavāra, ṅa, ra, asisirih, 5, ra. ca, asisirih, 4, ca. a, asisirih, 3, a. bu, asisirih, 7, bu. vrә, asisirih, 8, vrә. śu, asisirih, 6, śu. śa, asisirih, 9, śa. pha, sukha sugih, vәnaṅ sakāma-kāma.

hana brata, amaṅan sәkul slaṅgiaṅgi sarahup, sinaṅga ri taṅan kiva, tan patәḍa tan patambǝh, tigaṅ vәṅi samayanya, saṅ hyaṅ siddhi rakṣa sira turun abrata, uṅgvanira riṅ rāt, pha, tәḍunaniṅ drәman agave hayu, tan kapәjahan vәka kita, tәrus tumus tәkeṅ vәka vetbet.

hana brata, maṅan sәkul saravup, sinaṅga ri taṅan kiva, tan patәḍa tan patambǝh, ivaknya lalab kevala, 3, vәṅi lavasnya, kārya hana putra, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ sandi rasa sira turun abrata, uṅgvanira riṅ śarīra, riṅ rahasya, pha, duk hananiṅkәdhukaniṅ duman agave hayu, kveh putra kveh vvaṅ vәlas asih iri kita.
hana brata, amaṅan sinaṅga ri taṅan kiva, saivaknya, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, pakṣa hiḍǝp, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ kuvera hyaṅnya, ya pinakarūpa, pinakakulit, pinakaalis, pha, siddhiniṅ vvaṅ abәcik i pambǝkan.
hana brata, amaṅan sәkul, pituṅ lek divasanya, pha, akveh mahyun iri kita, anva ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, maṅan sәga kevala, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, hyaṅ puravat sira turun abrata, pha, sucāra vruh ri kaliṅanya.

hana brata, amaṅanmaṅan sәga putih, riṅyan taṅgal apisan, saṅ hyaṅ prasiddha turun abrata, satahun samayanyalavasanya, pha, kinasihaniṅkinasihan deniṅ rāt, ahiliranaṅliraṅamәliran ṅaraniṅharaniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, amaṅan ... brata maṅkana
in III.187 in III.61 quite similiar. Here is the text: hana brata amaṅan sәkul putih, yan taṅgal, 1, aliraṅ haraniṅ brata, saṅ hyaṅ prasiddha turun abrata, satavun samayanya, phalanya kinasihan deniṅ rāt in III.134
hana brata, amaṅan sәga balaka, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, saṅ hyaṅ paravan hyaṅnya, pha, vruhiṅ ācarā kaliṅanya.

hana brata, amaṅanmaṅan sәga putih, 5, puluṅ, kәtantәkan baṅ, 5, kәtansәgar jәnar, 5, tridhātusidhātu brata, 5, mañcavāra, saṅ hyaṅ padma rasa tumurun abratabrata, pinakasoca, bāyu śabda iḍǝp, pha, sugih tan hina saambǝk phalanya.
hana brata, maṅan ... saambǝk phalanya.
in III.189 in III.79
hana brata, añәkulañaṅkul slaṅgiaṅgi, ulam pahi, lamanyalama satәṅahtәṅah lek, ra nini pāduka bhaṭārī uma hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, avavanonwawanonvavadon vastusvasta, kinarmakәniṅ akvehakeh.

app.note:
hana brata, añәkul ... kinarmakәniṅ akveh
in III.190 in III.102

div.ab: hana brata, amaṅan sәkul slaṅgiaṅgi, anaṅgap, 7, pūr, sira saṅ hyaṅ viśeṣa tumurun abrata, pha, ginañjaran śakti lima, vadon viṣṇu anәmu, tan alәvasahalavas tur prajñan, vicakṣaṇa, sukha sugih riṅ dlāha.

hana brata, amaṅan sәkul pañcavarṇa, aren tiniṅkah cakra tinañcǝban vr̥ti, denta maṅan maṅkana tatkāla kalivon, añakra bhuvana, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ śivātma sira turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakayuṣa, pinakalaku, pha, dadi vvaṅ aṅuripi jagat, sukha sugih vәnaṅ pinakasāriniṅ jagat, riṅ niṣkala.
hana brata jaga varṇa, ṅa, amaṅan sәkul, balañan, pituṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, keḍәp deniṅ rāt, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, bisāgamǝl aṅiduṅ, vīryavan.
hana brata, yan amaṅan anǝmbah sәkul, pituṅ rātri divasanya, pha, kinasihaniṅ hyaṅ, śrī cittāmaṇi ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata naṅga sәkul, tinumpaṅan vr̥tti, yan pәjah ikaṅ vr̥ti, pavusan kita pamaṅan, pituṅ vәṅi lavasanya, pha, salviriṅ sañjataagata tan tame kita, aṅañcaṅ ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, yan amaṅan tinañcǝban vr̥tti vulan, saṅ hyaṅ anuṅkǝbi jagat hyaṅnya, ya pinakarūpaminakarūpa hayu apәkik, pha, riṅ dadi vvaṅ sukha sugih, vәnaṅ amatūt jagat riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, amaṅan tinañcǝban tuṅgul, tiniṅkah bhīma, hyaṅ maṇik teja, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ paṅirut jagat turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakalaku, pinakateja, pha, aśrī iṅiriṅ sañjata, sakṣat kǝmbaṅ tinuṅgulan, śakti aṅrәbahakǝn jagat riṅ niṣkala.
hana brata, avr̥tti, ṅa, yan amaṅan tinañcǝban vr̥tti, pәjah taṅ vr̥tti, avusan amaṅan, saptarātri divasanya, pha, sarvaroga tan tumameṅ śarīranta.
hana brata, aṅǝmbaṅ, ṅa, lamun amaṅan kǝmbaṅ rumuhun, tigaṅ tahun tigaṅ lek divasanya, bhaṭāra iśvara hyaṅnya, pha, deva sih iri kita.

hana brata, ṅǝmbaṅ, ṅa, tan luṅhā yan kaparan tamutatamu, bhaṭāra viśeṣa maveh brata, pha, sugih tan ilaṅ takonakәna, maṅgәh iṅamaṅgih deśa norana voṅ siddhi gave.
hana brata, ṅǝmbaṅ ... siddhi gave
in III.201 in III.88

hana brata aja tukar, ṅa, amaṅan asaṇdiṅ pulava kǝmbaṅ, salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra guru maveh brata, pha, akarma alaki anom, tur kinasihaniṅ paṇḍita.
hana brata aja tukar ... kinasihaniṅ paṇḍita
in III.202 in III.89
hana brata, maṅan kǝmbaṅ naṅkǝṅ umanismanis, hyaṅ maṇisumila haraniṅ brata, saṅ hyaṅ asmara hyaṅnya, ya pinakarūpa, aśrī sumilah, pasamūhaniṅ akvehakeh riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, yan amaṅan, tinumpaṅan kǝmbaṅ campaka, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik puḍak haraniṅ brata, hyaṅ vidakā turun abrata, ya pinakarūpaminakarūpa, apәkik anulus, pha, tumitisumitis iṅ menak, ring dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, vicakṣaṇa riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, maṅan lalab luṅluṅan, mvaṅ kinǝmbaṅakǝn, 2, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik arṣana hyaṅnya, bhaṭāra bāyu sira turun abrata, ya pinakarūpaminakarūpa, pinakaurip,, pinakarambut, pinakalǝye, pinakaiḍǝp, pinakagulū, pinakasindhuva, pinakalimbeyan, pha, riṅ dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, ambǝk ahәniṅ, akǝmbaṅ avohavәh riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, amaṅan lalab balaka, sambǝl sinamūhasinamohva, mantra pātāla, ṅa, hyaṅ basuki turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakālit, pinakadalamakaniṅ suku, pinakatahulan, pinakakәliṅ, pha, riṅ dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, lәmah sīma, kinapeṅin deniṅ voṅ riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, yan amaṅan tinumpaṅan vīja, saṅ hyaṅ vīra kusuma, ṅa, hyaṅ jayaniṅ rāt turun abrata, ya pinakarūpaminakarūpa, pinakajәnǝṅ, pinakapamulu, pha, śakti aheṅ rūpanta, riṅ dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, rāja drәve, mās pirak, putra putri riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, yan amaṅan tinumpaṅan sәkar vaṅi-vaṅi, saṅ hyaṅ mūrva gaṇḍa vaṅi haraniṅ brata, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik sumirit hyaṅniṅ brata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakakulit, pinakāmbə̄pinakāmbu, pha, riṅ dadi vvaṅ, mrәbuk arūm, anǝrus tәkeṅ kaḍaton riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, yan amaṅan sәkar śrīgaḍiṅ, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik śrī danti hyaṅniṅ brata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakagugusi, pinakahuntu, pha, aśrī sakeṅ huntunta, sukha sugih, saṅ hyaṅ vidayaka sira turun abrata, pinakarūpa, apәkik anulus, tumitisiṅ menak, prakavi vicakṣaṇa riṅ niṣkala.
hana brata, yan amaṅan alamak sukǝt, puṣpa nismr̥ti, ṅa, bhaṭāra smara hyaṅnya, ya pinakālas, nәhәr phalanya kinasihaniṅ bapebu.
hana brata, amaṅan alamak pattra, amūrti prāṇa, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ pagər gunuṅ sira turun abrata, ya pinakahuntu, pha, dīrgha yuṣa, pәjah tan pahavan kadga.

hana brata, amaṅan aharyanaren roṇḍon, pituṅ vulan pituṅ vәṅi divasanya, bhaṭāra mahīśvara hyaṅnya, pha, mulih mariṅ bhaṭāra mahiśvara, sasvarga sira, sasarnya majanma riṅ juru bhāṣa, labdhavāra ri saṅ ahulun.
hana brata, amaṅan aharyanaren upih, pinuluṅ kuyupakәna, pha, sugih dodot, mvaṅ siñjaṅ.
hana brata, amaṅan aharyanaren pampat, kvehnya, 73, aṇḍaniṅ janur, iṅaṅge, pha, sukha sugih, apәkik alus avakta, jarijinta lәmǝs.

hana brata, sarvagatasarvaghaṭa, ṅa, yan amaṅan tan pahupa, pataṅ lek pataṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, bisa gamәl aṅiduṅ, vāk bajra siddhimantra, jayeṅ śatru keḍәp deniṅ rāt, sukha sugih saṅkan rare.

hana brata, asiṅ ṅaranya, pisan amaṅan kinaṅ, yan amaṅan sumәlap aṅinaṅ, nәhәr tan pahupa, salek lavasnya, bhaṭārī uma hyaṅniṅ brata, ma, om̐ yanā devī nama svāhā, ahes, pha, sukha sugih amǝpǝki kaḍaton.

hana brata, tan paṅinaṅ, añǝmbuṅanәmbaṅ kevala, salek samayanyasaulan, saṅ hyaṅ kāma jayamajaya hyaṅniṅhyaniṅ brata, pha, abhrāabhru sumilahdumilah miyat kabeh, keḍǝp paṅucapta deniṅ rāt.
hana brata, tan ... deniṅ rāt
in III.218 in III.77
hana brata, saṅga ṅinaṅ, ṅa, satahun salek lavasnya, pha, drәman malaky arabi, ratu asih, ahes, ma, om̐ bra śrī vastuya nama svāhā.

hana brata, asihaniṅ layon, ṅa, aṅinaṅ tan pambuñcal sәpah, tigaṅ tahun samayanya, sahiṅ sәpah kinumpulakǝnkinampelakǝn, bhinasmi, iki pituturnya, ma, om̐ bhaṭāra mati, ahurip mani amor iṅ megha, tumitis dadi sarvaendahsarvendah, pinakabhuktiniṅ hulun, sa ba ta a i namā śivāya.
hana brata, asihaniṅ ... nama śivāya
in III.219 in III.112

hana brata, aḍahar pucaṅ satәṅahtәṅah vәlas, ulamaniṅ pahi, ra nini pāduka bhaṭārī anuṅku rāt hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, abәcik kaṅ jariji.
hana brata, aḍahar ... abәcik kaṅ jariji
in III.220 in III.100

hana brata, yan amaṅan asaṇḍiṅ dhūpa damar, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik teja, ṅa, hyaṅ maṇik muntab sira turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakateja, śakti mahabhāra, pha, riṅ dadi vvaṅ, abhrā murub sumilah, aheṅ jәrih kaṅ rāt denta.

hana brata, damarmar aguṅ ṅaranya, tan pamaṅan kasurupan saṅ hyaṅ sūrya, savarṣa lamanyasәṅkәrnya, kaṅ pinaṅanpinaṅanya, yuyukanyuyuk, bavaṅ uṅkul, tarasi, sasivi, raraka malo, caṅkuk sarvan vinuṅkul, prut amuradaṅanamūradaṇan, pha, kacakṣu riṅ sarvarusitsarvarusik, luputiṅ sarvaśāstra, tan maṅhel vinuruknyavinurukta, tumusiṅ aji, aṅlariṅtaṅlariṅ kevuh, bhaṭāra śiva hyaṅniṅhyaṅnira hyaṅniṅ brata.
hana brata, damar ... hyaṅniṅ brata
in III.222 in III.120
hana brata, pasaṅ saṇḍe, ṅa, tan pamaṅan kasurupan saṅeṅe, pha, apaḍaṅ kaṅ hati, yan asisinahu eṅgal bisa.

hana brata, tan pamaṅanpaṅan riṅ pūrṇamaniṅ kadaśa, antuk tigaṅ pūrṅamaniṅ kadaśa, pha, svarga sakala katәmu,katәmu sakala mañjanma riṅ ratu, paripūrṇānurāga riṅ rāt.
hanā brata, tan ... riṅ rāt
in III.224 in III.99

hana brata, mūrṇamaamūrṇama sadā, ṅa, pūrṇama tan pamaṅanpaṅan tәkaniṅ paṅloṅ apisan, tilǝm tәkaniṅ taṅgal apisan, phaphalanya, sugih manәrussugih manәrus, katәkantәkana, sapinakṣanirapinakṣanira riṅ bhūmiriṅ bhūmi, saṅ prajuritiṅ bhūmisaṅ prajuritiṅ bhūmi hyaṅniṅ bratahyaṅnya hyaṅniṅ.
hana brata, mūrṇama ... hyaṅniṅ brata
in III.225 in III.107
hana brata akasukhan, ṅa, riṅ pūrṇamaniṅ kapitu, piṅ, 7, sarahina, piṅ, 7, savәṅi, amaṅan aṅinum, aṅigǝl, bhaṭāra kapitu maveh brata, pha, sukha sugih, anak amitra, dīrgha yuṣa, keḍәp kapintuhu.
hana brata, mәnǝr ri taṅgal, piṅ, 3, maṅan kuñit, mūrṇamasadā, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ trisandhi hyaṅniṅ brata, papalihan bhaṭāra mahādeva, ya pinakarūpa, pinakapamulu, mvaṅ kavicakṣaṇan, pha, tan kaluputan.
taṅgal, piṅ, 4, amaṅan kәtan irәṅ, amuktilabdha, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ cadu śakti hyaṅniṅ brata, papalihan bhaṭāra viṣṇu, ya pinakarūpa, pinakarambut, pha, siddhaniṅ ṅvaṅ, anvargakǝn bapebu.

taṅ, piṅ, 5, amañcavāra śakti, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ pañcavāra hyaṅniṅ brata, papalihan bhaṭāra śiva, ya pinakarūpaminakarūpa, pinakaiḍәpminakaiḍәp, pinakatәṇḍasminakatәṇḍas pha, siddhaniṅ ṅvaṅ sugih tan kaharṣa.

hana brata maṅanamaṅan raka, pūrṇama tilәmlima ṅraka, sira saṅ hyaṅ patūtpatūtan sih tumurun abrata, pha, ginañjaran śakti lima, pinakalalakonpinakārama, pinakalalalon sukha sugih tan panambut kārya.
hana brata maṅan ... panambut kārya
in III.228 in III.110
hana brata, mūrṇama tilәm, ṅa, maṅupavāsa, aṅraka kunǝṅ, pha, utaṅiṅ atvanta, kәna sinahur polihnya sakarәpta.
hana brata, ṅraka naṅkǝn kalivon, patra, ṅa, hyaṅ taruṇa turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pha, siddhaniṅ vaṅ sugih lәmah sīma.
hana brata, maṅan sarvaphala, talǝs huvi vahvahan pisaṅ kunaṅ, pituṅ vәṅi lavasnya, kasubhagan kinaharṣan deniṅ strīistri phalanya, abhoh kayu ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.
hana brata, maṅan phala gantuṅ, davun sinabraṅ, ṅa, pha, prajurit.
hana brata, maṅan sarvabuṅkah, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, saṅ hyaṅ viśeṣa hyaṅniṅ brata, sukha sugih, puṣṭaka lǝṅǝn phalanya.
hana brata, amaṅan sarvaphala, saptarātri lavasnya, pha, kinasihaniṅ strī, yaniṅ strī kinasihaniṅ kakuṅ.

hana brata, amaṅan tur ambaṅkit, bhaṭārī keḍәp hyaṅniṅ brata, ṅgonaniṅ amimiti, riṅ pavon, punaṅ kininaṅ sәḍah sapon den tuvuh, lalamak lampuyaṅ, tan pamaṅan tan paṅinaṅ, yan tan paṅgugut lampuyaṅ, pha, vavadon tan pagigilutan, keḍәp malaki.
hana brata, amaṅan katambat tigaṅ bulih, naṅkǝn kalivon, tan pamaṅan paran-paran, pituṅ kalivon samayanya, pha, apәkik tur lǝmǝsiṅ rambut.
hana brata, ambhūmi lәpa, ṅa, amaṅan jaṅaniṅ lǝlǝpa kabeh, salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra īśvara maveh brata, pha, kinasihaniṅ svami, keḍәp alaki, kinasihaniṅ hyaṅ.
hana brata, amaṅana mimba, salek lavasnya, pha, athāravit.

hana brata, sarvatatā, ṅa, amaṅan luṅggahiṅ gaṇḍagada rusa kәliṅ, mvaṅ campaka garus, bhaṭāra śambhu hyaṅnya, pha, mulih, riṅ svargasvargan bhaṭāra guru, mvaṅ riṅ bhaṭāra śiva.
hana brata, sarvatatā ... bhaṭāra śiva
in III.239 in III.80

hana brata, vījahāramiśahara, ṅa, amaṅan vījasarvavīja rumuhun, saha pucukiṅ gaṇḍa rusarusa kәliṅ, pucukiṅ alaṅ-alaṅalalaṅ, pha, prajñanprajñanaprāṇa kita, sihaniṅkinasihaniṅkinasihan deniṅ strīistri.
hana brata, vijāharā ... sihaniṅ strī in III.33 in III.240 in III.15 in III.33
hana brata, maṅan sarvaluṅgah-luṅgahan, pucukiṅ dukut lәpas, pucukiṅ alaṅ-alaṅ, tuñjuṅ, vīja tәluṅ jumput, saptarātri pituṅ dina lavasanya, siddhakārya saphalanya, amūrva ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

hana brata ṅantavali, ṅa, amaṅan antavali, pañjaṅnya salǝṅkat madhya, pituṅ tumpǝk kalivon patәlasanya, mirica pituṅ viji, ligundi pituṅ muñcuk, pha, salara vighna hilaṅ donya, sojarira keḍәp,
katәmu maṅke mvaṅ dlāha.
hana brata nirambə̄nirambu, ṅa, tan pamaṅan sarvainambwansarvabinumbon, satahun lavasnya, pha, mulih mariṅ svarga bhaṭāra rudra, sasarnya majanma ri listvayu, apәkik prajurit.
hana brata, amaṅan kәtan baṅ pituṅ vәṅi, hirәṅ pituṅ vәṅi, ivaknya sarvaśuci, arariṅ śakti, ṅa, bhagavān paraśara hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, akadaṅ voṅ pәkik.

hana brata, amaṅanmaṅan kәtanlikәtan taṅkǝpya takǝptakәp, voṅ tuṅgal tuṅgal riṅ kalivon, 7, hǝmbanya phala, sahaṅ, mәñanmәñan, sahaṅ, aṅgara kasih amaṅan, 7, alaṇḍeyan, sira saṅ hyaṅ asihiṅ prāṇa turunsira turun abrata, ginañjaran śakti lima, pha, sukha sugih, saaptinyasapatinya vәnaṅ.
hana brata, maṅan ... saaptinya vәnaṅ
in III.245 in III.108
hana brata, anīla, ṅa, amaṅan kәtan hirәṅ, satahun samayanya, pha, mantuk iṅ svarga bhaṭāra viṣṇu, sasarnya majanma riṅ mantrī.
hana brata, murāṇa, ṅa, amaṅan ñahñah lan gula tәbu, lamanya tigaṅ dina, pha, tan kataman siṅ saparanta.
hana brata, maṅan tan dady akarvan, pituṅ lek lavasnya, sukha magәṅ phalanya, ekapatra ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

hana brata, tan kapaḍan, ṅa, yan amaṅan tan pakǝmbulan, aduluran pañcamuna, sahuripnya riṅ amaṅan, alalab roṇḍon, mvaṅ kǝmbaṅ, uttamaniṅ brata kabeh, pha, tan kapaḍan viśeṣa, maṅkana polahira saṅ viku tәmǝn tәmǝn.

hana brata, amaṅan tan pakǝmbulankramanya tan vәnaṅ akәmbulan amaṅantan kavaś amaṅan akәmbulan, pәtaṅ tahunvarṣa samayanya, pha, mantuk riṅ svargasvargan bhaṭāra rudra, sasarnya mañjanmajanma riṅ kulaputravikulaputra, kaḍaṅakaḍaṝ haji subhaganuraga.

hana brata, aṅajum, ṅa, amaṅan riṅ vaton, salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra mahādeva maveh brata, pha, tәka atuduhiṅ paliṅgihan, keḍәp tәka ruruṅeniṅ voṅ.
hana brata, ṅajum ... ruruṅeniṅ voṅ
in III.251 in III.83

hana brata, amutәriṅ paṅkon, ṅa, amaṅanamaṅun pinaṅku, salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra mahādeva maveh brata, pha, kinasihan deniṅ bapa ibu, malaky arabisatya rabi, sasarnya dadi bhujaṅga lәvih.
hana brata, amutәriṅ ... bhujaṅga lәvih
in III.252 in III.84
hana brata, amaṅan ry aghūrṇita, pituṅ lek samayanya, pha, siddhimantra, listvayu paripūrṇa.

hana brata, naṅkənāratan aṅkәn nara, ṅa, yan amaṅan aṅagǝm jinahjina, 7pituṅ, leksalek samayanya, saṅ hyaṅ rudra hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, akәlar tantane kәneṅ griṅśrī kita.
hana brata, naṅkə̄nāra ... griṅ kita
in III.254 in III.78

hana brata, asaṇḍiṅ ... patih sugih
in III.255 in III.90

hana brata, maṅanamaṅan aṅadut, satahun lavasnya, pha, sugih siddhi mandi, vākavakmahavak bajra subhaga.
hana brata, maṅan ... bajra subhaga
in III.88 in III.256 in III.122

hana brata, amaṅan kupat pāṇḍava, 3, paṅanǝnpaṅanәnәn esukaesuk, 1, paṅanǝn tәṅah ṅvetaṅaṅetәṅaṅe, 1, paṅanǝn sore, 1, pha, rinakṣa deniṅ rāt, kinasavitan deniṅ samantasama janma,janma, haja nali vavaktayanya tan pamuruṅpamurup polihnyaolihnya.
hana brata, amaṅan ... pamuruṅ polihnya
in III.257 in III.72
hana brata, maṅan kupat, mevaka sarvaśukla, tәluṅ vәṅi divasanya, bhaṭāra īśvara hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, bisa ṅiduṅ, abәcikiṅ ulon, manisiṅ panutukan, mvaṅ kinasihaniṅ voṅ.
hana brata, aḍahar lәpǝt, lama tәṅah vulan, ra nini kuṇḍaṅ kasih hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, arampiṅ.

hana brata, naḍah tumpəṅ, sahasta pañjaṅnya, śūnya ivaknya uyah harәṅ kevala, anarasvatī, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ pitu tan palavan hyaṅniṅ brata, ya pinakaprajña, pha, sih malaky arabi, siddhani ṅvaṅ sugih tan surud, mvaṅ pradaṇānuṅku rāt.
hana brata, maṅan tumpəṅ, lavasnya tәṅah śaśih, lamun tan kavaśa, pituṅ dina, ra nini paduka bhaṭārī hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, abәcik kaṅ gulū.

hana brata, advaaṅadoadәṅo savәguṅ, bhaṭāra rudra maveh brata, pha, sugih rumbe.
hana brata, adwa ... sugih rumbe
in III.262 in III.91

hana brata, asiḍakǝp sarahina, bhaṭāra śaṅkara maveh brata, pha, kinasihaniṅ voṅ.
hana brata, asidakǝp ... kinasihaniṅ voṅ
in III.263 in III.144 in III.92

hana brata, lumaku ... tәrus tumus
in III.264 in III.145 in III.93

hana brata, amәlәṅ tutuk sarahina savәṅivәṅi, marәp pūrvapūr, saṅ hyaṅ anәmu jagat sira turun abrata, pha, ginañjaran śakti lima, pinakarāmapinakarapi, pinakalalakon vadonvaṅ vadon, lituhyulistvayulistuhayu, prajñan, lanaṅ vicakṣaṇa, sukha sugih, maṅkemaṅke kaṅ kalavan tǝmbe.
hana brata, amәlәṅ ... kalavan tǝmbe
in III.265 in III.148 in III.107

hana brata ṅālamuñəṅ, ṅapūr, saṅ hyaṅ lәbur jagat sira turun abrata, ginañjaran śakti lima, voṅ tuṅgal sakvehiṅ sira abrata, ya pinakarūpayan pinakapūpa, pinakalakonpinakalalakon, vastu rahayu, lanaṅ vadon sukha sugih drәman keḍәp.
hana brata ṅalamuñәṅ ... drәman keḍǝp
in III.266 in III.113
hana brata, ṅālacakra, ṅa, sira saṅ hyaṅ viśeṣa riṅ bhuvana, sira turun abrata, ginañjaran śakti tigaṅ rakṣa, sakvehaniṅ abrata, pha, sukha sugih, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, lanaṅ vadon.

hana brata, mañcavaśa giṇa, ṅa, tan paṅlavaniṅ vadon aṅucap, naṅkǝn umanis, yan vadon tan paṅucapiṅ kakuṅ, tan paṅinaṅ suruhiṅ apvan, lǝlǝmbaran vәnaṅ, pituṅ lek samayanya, pha, tinūtiṅ mās, salviriṅ drәventa tǝmbe.

hanahana brata, kukusaniṅ śarīra, ṅa, tan pamaṅan suku pat, lavasnya sakavaśaniṅsakavaśahaniṅ abrata, saṅ hyaṅ caduśakticanduśakti sira turun abrata, ya pinakarūpaminakarūpā, pinakavaṅkoṅ, siddhaniṅ vvaṅ muṣṭika, akveh avәlas, rovaṅ asih iri kitarovaṅ akeh avәlas riṅ sira, aṅraṅkusaṅraṅkul aṅraṅkus brata.
hana brata, kukuśaniṅ ... aṅraṅkus brata
in III.269 in III.74

hana brata, tan pamaṅan bavi, hyaṅ manasija hyaṅnya, pituṅ tahun samayanyalavasnya, pha, luputiṅ gәriṅ aguṅ, tur kinasihan deniṅ jagat.
hana brata, tan ... deniṅ jagat
in III.270 in III.103

hana brata, tan pamaṅan śr̥gāla, pha, rūpanta tan akusut.
hana brata, tan ... tan akusut
in III.271 in III.104
hana brata, tan pamaṅan ayam, pituṅ lek samayanya, pha, tan pamaṅgih maru.

hana brata, tan pamaṅan ayamivak ayam, satahun samayanyalavasnya, pha, tan panәmu maru, tur drәman.
hana brata, tan ... tur drәman
in III.273 in III.137
hana brata, akәrisa, ṅa, tan pamaṅan yan tan pasisig rumuhun, sari-sari, bhaṭārī śvari hyaṅniṅ brata, satahun sayamanya, pha, prajña, tavitan labdha mās kita.

hana brata ñaṇḍiṅ ḍaḍap, lama tigaṅ dinatigaṅ dina lavasnya, tan pamaṅan,pamaṅan, vәkasanya maṅkana, bhaṭāra śiva hyaṅnyahyaṅniṅ brata, pha, svarga lәvih dinuṅkapnya, subhagasubhaga kita, añjanma ri kulaputra, atәhǝr viśeṣa, bahudaṇḍabahudhǝṇdhabavudaṇdha ñakravartiñakravr̥tti.
hana brata ñandiṅ ... bahuḍaṇḍa ñakravarti
in III.275 in III.114

hana brata, ṅapitu, ṅa, naṅkǝn dvadaśi śukla pakṣaniṅ kapitu, aṅupavāsa, bhaṭāra bhīma hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ bam̐ bhīmāya namaḥ, pamit, pha, vīryavan kapintuhu deniṅ rāt, sugih mās pirak, hulun putra vr̥ddhi, siddha sakāryanta.

hana brata, ṅrәspatimaṅvr̥spati, ṅa, kramanya anaṅkǝn vrәspati ṅupavāsa,kramanya aṅupavāsa, manaṅkәn vr̥spati pha, listuhayu kita, siṅ kāryantakinārya hayu.
hana brata, ṅr̥spati ... kāryanta hayu
in III.277 in III.119
hana brata, tan pamaṅan pituṅ rātri, pha, vīryavan siddha sakāryanta.
hana brata, ṅupavāsa, sacandra samayanya, riṅ kasapuluh, pha, kapituhu deniṅ rāt, mās pirak tәka vr̥ddhi, kinasihan deniṅ paṇḍita.

hana brata, yan tәkaniṅ vәton, tanaja pamaṅanmaṅan sarvāmbǝkansarvamambәkan, pha, antuka omah-omah, tan surud dharmanya, bhaṭārahyaṅ rudra hyaṅnya.
hana brata, yan ... rudra hyaṅnya
in III.280 in III.110, III.136
hana brata tan pamaṅan sarvāmbǝkan, pva, ka, pha, keḍәp deniṅ rāt.
hana brata, amiraṅ, ṅa, tan pamaṅan sarvaprāṇa prāṇi, satahun tigaṅ lek samayanya, bhaṭārī pabyavara hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, siṅ prih meṅgal katәmu, deva sih iri kita.

hana brata, yan amaṅan asaṇḍiṅ puṣpa liṅga, aṅliga prāṇa, ṅaharaniṅ brata, hyaṅ aṅgaṣṭi sira turun abrata, pha, keḍәpiṅ rāt, tur rūpantarūpantu muntab, śaktiśakәti prajurit mahābhāramahambara, yan dadi vvaṅ abhrā murub, tan kasoran rūpanta, dīrgha yuṣa paripūrṇa, puruṣa viśeṣaviśeṣa.
hana brata, yan ... puruṣa viśeṣa
in III.283 in III.25
hana brata, aṅliṅga pәraṅ, ṅa, yan amaṅan asaṇḍiṅ duhuṅ, bhaṭāra rudra hyaṅiṅ brata, pha, akveh vvaṅ tumaṅgalaṅ asih iri kita.
hana brata, aṅubi, ṅa, amaṅan aṅinum bañu rumuhun, huvusiṅ amaṅan, tan vәnaṅ aṅucap lavan voṅ, pha, akәlar, sukha sugih, tan kǝna griṅ, tan sasar kapintuhu deniṅ rāt.

hana brata, maṅan tan pembuh, tan paṅinum bañu, pha, śakti kiteṅ ri niṣkala, lavasnya sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, saṅ hyaṅ dura dasih hyaṅnya, tatkālaniṅ abrata, tan paturviṅ rahina, pha, apaḍaṅ riṅ rūpa, apaḍaṅ kaṅ hati, kinasihaniṅ rāt.

hana brata, ñәkul bañu, ṅa, tan pamaṅan sәga sadina, tan paturviṅ rahina vәṅi, aṅayapakǝn tәkeṅ polihnya, añjanma hayu, ma, rāga śūnya mahiśi taya, amaṅan sәga satatak, siniratiṅ toya añar, pamit, vus mapamit, maḍahar, sakantunanya, hayva mañapuhaṅ.

hana brata ñәkul bañu, mañjiṅ lima ṅaranya, kavaśa amaṅan suruh, maṅan sәkul inumi toya, sәga sakәpǝl tinatak ri lәpa lәpaniṅ taṅan, vәnaṅ inumi bañu sabran sore, lavasiṅ abrata, satahun, yan kavaśa, mokṣa salviriṅ lara, vighnaniṅ śarīra hilaṅ donya.

hana brata, tan paṅinum vvai, tatkāla savuku galuṅan, ṅhiṅ tāmaṅan hantiga binәnәm, harәpiṅ ḍәṅǝn, sambi aṅadǝg tәṅah ṅve tatkāla guṅe, ardhana bhaṭāra mr̥tyu, phalanya kәdhuk timbul, tutug tumuvuh, puruṣa viśeṣa, śakti vani, kineriṅan deniṅ jagat, labdhavāra gragaluṅan.
hana brata, aṅambaṅ, ṅa, yan amaṅan kinambaṅakәn riṅ bañu, satahun samayanya, bhaṭāra viṣṇu maveh brata, pha, mañjanma riṅ kaḍaṅ aji, sugih vәsi, tur keḍәp kavi prajurit.

[nyan ta saṅ citta varaṇā, umarah ri
saṅ vala kula, mūla tattvaniṅ dadi kabeh, pahenak paṅrәṅə̄nta, mūlabhoktaniṅ kanirāśrayan, mvaṅ kābhyudayan, bhāvanya mvaṅ lakṣaṇanya, pūrvanya mvaṅ vәkasnya, maṅkana liṅ saṅ vala kula, nǝmbah hulun, om̐ viku satakvan tānaku, kita pva śikṣā ṅaran ika, duga-duga tumakvan, vuvus maṅkana, rәṅə̄n siptani ṅhulun.
pūrvam śrī puruṣānte, varānugraha makanya, saṅ rojyam, narāsakane, ayavam vidyām prajayam.
maṅkana pariñciniṅ cipta, kaliṅanya, pūrva haraniṅ mimitan, tripuruṣa haraniṅ brahmā viṣṇu īśvara, vara ṅaraniṅ amidhi, anugraha haraniṅ panuṅsuṅ, manoka ṅaraniṅ devata, saroja ṅaraniṅ manūtra, nara ṅaraniṅ mānuṣa, sakāla ṅaraniṅ samaṅke, yaśa ṅaraniṅ kirti, vidyā ṅaraniṅ aji, aprayadha ṅaraniṅ pūjā,
kaliṅanya, bhaṭāra sira magave pratapa riṅ vana giri, maṅaṣkāra bhaṭāra, bhaṭārī, atitah kasukhan amragat trәṣṇa, anusupi vanavāsa, maṅǝnakǝn tapa, manaṅsāra rāga, tinūt deniṅ manūṣa maṅke, atapa abrata, ayoga asamadhī, ayajña dāna kīrti,
maṅhanakǝn brata apayapanya, ulandriya, rumәgǝp pañcendriya, tuṅgalakәna riṅ trisandhyā, piṇdhakǝn riṅ kaparāmarthan, vaḍahana yoga, sahabana samadhi, tindihana brata, tuṅgunǝniṅ dāna kīrti, laṅlaṅana riṅ āgama, pagǝrana pupūjān sasapon, lavaṅana saṅgarma, ugǝr-ugǝrana sadā, inǝbana tuhu, tindihana kañciṅana parāmartha,
yeka ulahaniṅ saṅ tumaki-taki kābhyudayan, kābhyudayan ṅaranya, kavibhavan, kavibhavan ṅaranya, bandha savita, bandha savita ṅaranya, kasugihan kula rūpa, śakti vani, niroga nirvighna, cakṣyah lavajjana, subrata dīrgha yuṣa yovaṇa avet aurip, maṅkana phalaniṅ brata yan inabhyāsa, ya kābhyudayan de saṅ surupa, maṅkana liṅ saṅ citta varaṇa, riṅ saṅ vala kula.
nambah hulun, mapa riṅ kanirāśrayan, mәne pukulun, mәne kami varah iri kita, lakoni siptaṅku riṅ lagi rumuhun, sājña pukulun, vurukәniṅ brata pukulun, pariñcinya, mvaṅ phalanya, a u ma.]

hana brata, tan pamaṅan tan paturu, bratanira saṅ hyaṅ vәkasniṅ kavi viśeṣa, pha, svarga lәvih, titisnya añakravartiañakravartti, subhaga anulus, anurāga riṅ rāt, katәkan sapinakṣanira riṅ bhūmi, dinuluriṅ hayu, śakti vani mahābhāra.
hana brata, ambhairava pakṣa, siṅ pinaṅan, tuhun tan trәṣṇeṅ turu, bhaṭāra pavakānugrahani, mvaṅ devata, pha, bhūta gandharva masih, janmanya puruṣa viśeṣa, subhaga anulus, ajrih kaṅ sarvagalak.

hana brata, tanntan paṅgilanipaṅilaniṅ sarvatinaḍahtaḍah sarvatinaḍah, vunive taḍah, sambaranabrata sambarā, ṅa, pha, vīryavansiddha vīryavan siddha sugihsugih saṅkansaṅan rare.
hana brata, tan ... saṅkan rare
in III.293 in III.87

hana brata, ṅarәṅ, ṅa, amaṅan harәṅ rumuhun, bhaṭārī gaṅga hyaṅniṅ brata, ma, om̐ gaṅgāya namaḥ, salek samayanya, pha, tan kerәṅan deniṅ jagat.
hana brata, ṅarәṅ ... deniṅ jagat
in III.294 in III.75
hana brata, yan amaṅan maivak harәṅ tumpə̄r, pәtaṅ tahun samayanya, pha, keḍәp riṅ samanta janma, kinasihaniṅ rāt, keḍәpiṅ arabi anak-anak.
hana brata, maṅan apisan, pituṅ lek pituṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, kinasihaniṅ rāt.

hana brata nitīkramaanītikrama, ṅa, amaṅan sadina sapisan, saṅ hyaṅhyaṅ smara hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, siṅ prih meṅgal katәmukatәkan, dīrgha yuṣa.
hana brata, maṅan pisan ... kinasihaniṅ rāt
in III.297 in III.117
nahan brata, maṅan piṅ saptasaptami, pituṅ lek samayanya, kinasihaniṅ rāt phalanya.
hana brata, ambhūmi amasar bhuvana, ṅa, pha, sugih lәmah sīma.
hana brata, maṅan iṅ lәmah, pituṅ śaśih lavasnya, kinasihaniṅ rāt phalanya, bhūmi ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

hana brata, mañcavāra, ṅa, u, marәp maṅetan amaṅan, pa, marәp kidul amaṅan. pva, marәp aṅulon. va, marәp aṅalor amaṅan. ka, siṅ harәpira maṅan, duluranya lalab kabeh, mvaṅ kǝmbaṅ anūt kadi varṇaniṅ sәga, pañcavarṇa, putih kuniṅ abaṅ irәṅ, riṅ teṅah pañcavarṇa, deva rata hyaṅnya, pha, mantuk iṅ svarga pada bhaṭāra śiva, sasarnya mañjanma ratu cakravartiañakravrtti, tan kapaḍan. ma, om̐ om̐ śrī jagat guru padukebhyo namaḥ, pamit.

hana brata, mañcavāra dalәm, ṅa, kramanya, amaṅan uyah kevala, amaṅan sәkul kevala, salek tәluṅ dina samayanya, vus maṅkana, ulam kevala, vus maṅkana, toya kevala, vus maṅkana, aṅinaṅ kevala, vus maṅkana lavasnya, kәneṅ paṅan, tan kәneṅ turu, samaṅkana lavasnya, saṅ hyaṅ vәkasiṅ anuṅku rāt hyaṅnya ikaṅ brata, tan upir-upir sukhanta, mantuk riṅ svargan bhaṭāra dharma, janmanya sukha maṅan aṅaṅgur, tan aṅhel panambut gave, sukha sugih tan pasaṅkan, kaṅ vvaṅ masih deva bikṣuka, mulihmuleh iri kita.

hana brata, luhuriṅ kayu, ṅa, tigaṅ lek samayanya, pha, vr̥ddhi putra, tur keḍәp siṅkeḍәpiṅ paṅucap.
hana brata, luhuriṅ ... siṅ paṅucap
in III.303 in III.98
hana brata, aturu luhuriṅ kayu, salek divasanya, pha, śakti kasiddhyan kapaṅguh.

hana brata, aṅalasaaṅelaśaaṅalesa, ṅa, asaṅidan iṅriṅ alas savәguṅavәguṅ, tan papasakapapasa deniṅ voṅ, ṅunivehunikaṅunakaṅ sarvasato, asǝpasәpnya, pha, prajurit riṅ paravu, aṅuṅgahana bahanya, veva, harәṅ prajurit riṅ ḍarat lugutanatluṅgutana vatu, saṅ buddha asuṅ bratasubrata, sasarnya dadi dam puhavaṅmpu vavaṅdәmpu havaṅ riṅ parahuprabhu, sugih savahtur sugih savah, tur sugih parahutur sugih jə̄ṅ.
hana brata, haṅelaśa ... sugih paravu
in III.305 in III.146 in III.96
hana brata, ṅraka sabran tilәm mvaṅ pūrṇama, sarvaputus, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ silih asih maveh brata, pha, tinuṅgviṅ rāma rena, sukha sugih prih avak, tur tan paṅubiṅ voṅ atuha.
hana brata, maṅan gǝḍaṅ tan kinulitan, tәluṅ vәṅi samayanya, saṅ hyaṅ murṣita hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, apәkik, yen strīistri mǝṅgǝpiṅ pahyunan, abәcikiṅ buddhi, vruhiṅ kaliṅanya, pituturiṅ bapebu.

hana brata, maṅan tuhuṅ pitpit rumuhun, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik muñcar, ṅaraniṅ brata, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik aṅuñci pǝpǝt sira turun abrata, pinakabhaga, pinakarūpa, paṅadǝganiṅ vavadon, pinakalituhayupinakalistvayu, pha, drәman manis ta kita, lindihǝn voṅ apәkik, drәman anak anak, aputu riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, milirṅgilirlir kacaṅ, ṅa, kramanya, aṅupavāsa savәguṅ, amaṅan savәguṅ, hyaṅ prajābraja sadā hyaṅniṅ bratahyaṅnya, pha, mantuk riṅ svargan bhaṭāra iśvara, sasarnya mañjanmapañjanma riṅ kulaputra sukha sugih, lәvih anulusalus, yan lanaṅlanaṅ puruṣa kula pratyakṣa anurāga kita, sugih pisis riṅ dlāha, yan strīistri samaṅkanaviśeṣa subhaga riṅ dlahā.
hana brata, milir ... strī samaṅkana
in III.309 in III.115

hana brata, yan amaṅan sinaren kasumba, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik pari rāja, ṅa, hyaṅ maṇik teja bhūmi turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakarah-dagiṅ, pinakahati, pha, riṅ dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, lituhayulistvayu, sәkar tan alum, akǝmbaṅ avoh riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, maṅan sәkul sapuluṅ, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik tampa, ṅaraniṅ brata, saṅ hyaṅ maṇḍala hyaṅniṅ brata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakakukusaniṅ śarīra, pha, asǝsǝkan kanaka aguṅ, kalavan alit, aśrī asambaṅ jarijya, siddhaniṅ vvaṅ sukha sugih, tan pәgat sādhana, mvaṅ mās maṇik, kinaṇṭi jagat kinaṇṭi japa kita riṅ dlāha.

hana brata, maṅan sәkul putih kuniṅ, aṅkǝn kalivon, umarәp pūrva, mevaka bhīra, paṅan pisan saṅaṅ kalivon divasanya, uttama saṅaṅ vulan, bhaṭāra śiva hyaṅniṅ brata, papalihan hyaṅ antadeva, ya pinakarūpa, pinakasamūha, pinakadīrgha yuṣa, yan lanaṅ pinakapәkikan, pinakapolah, pinakararas, yan vadon pinakakahayon pinakapolah, pinakaibon, pha, mulihiṅ svarga bhaṭāra śiva, sasarnya mañjanma riṅ prabhu añakravarti viku, bhujaṅga, śeva sogata, sugih malǝṅkәrmalǝṅkә riṅ mās pirak, sarvasosoca, rare, hulun, kәbo sapi, mr̥gādi, vr̥ddhi putra, tinuṅgviṅ bapebu, kaki nini, ma, om̐ hram̐ hrim̐ sah paramaśivādityāya namaḥ, ahyas.

hana brata, amiśeṣa, ṅa, yan amaṅan tan pahupahupa, anәlasana sәkul, yan vus kinurәn-kurәn, ma, atma tuturakәna mariṅ bhaṭāra viśeṣa, umuṅguhvus ahamuṅguh riṅ vindu nādhanagha, sakala niṣkala, viśeṣa bhaṭāra baja, maty aturu, maty aluṅguh, maty aṅadǝgahadәg, lәsa alәyǝplәm alәyәp, pavak tan paśarīra sakala niṣkala.
hana brata,amiśeṣa ... sakala niṣkala
in III.313 in III.112

hana brata, nūtakǝn saśila bhaṭārabhattira gaṇa, amuṣpa gaṇa, ṅa, yan amaṅan sәga nǝm kǝpǝl, sarahina, tiṅkahiṅ amaṅan, śīla gaṇa, nǝm vulan samayanya, pha, mantuk iṅ bhaṭāra guru, sasarnya mañjanma riṅ viku ijo, śakti dūradarśana, sojarira keḍǝp.

hana brata, maṅan sәga sinaṅga ri taṅan kiva, tan patәḍa, tan patambǝh, tan apilih ivaknya, apadmayoniamanmayoni, ṅa, hyaṅ siddhi narasiṅha turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakalaku, pha, siddhaniṅ vaṅ anambaddhani śabda, sihniṅ rāt, ma, om̐ om̐ siddhi kāraṇāya namaḥ svāhā, yan ahyas.
hana brata, jaṅga varṇa, ṅa, amaṅan sәga balaka, pituṅ dina lavasnya mabhyāsa, pha, keḍәp savuvusta deniṅ rāt, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, biṣa gamǝl aṅiduṅ.

hana brata, jaga śatru, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ saptanala hyaṅniṅ brata, kramanya, taṅgal pisan piṅ ro tәmu taṅgal piṅ pitu, lamun huvus sumurup vulan juga kita vәnaṅ aturu, livat saṅkeṅ taṅgal piṅ pitu, sakarәptāturu, maṅkaneṅ krәṣṇa pakṣa, lamun mәtu vulan juga kita turu, livat saṅke rika, sakarәpta turu, pha, riṅ dadi vvaṅ sugih, tan hana nuskr̥ta, riṅ niṣkala.
hana brata, mārabmūrāba, ṅa, maṅlәkasa taṅgal iṅ kapat mabrata, maṅana purāṇa, kǝmbaṅ nāgasāri, kulalaṭa, malabahan iṅ pūrṇama, polihnyāpәkik hayu tan pasiriṅ, ma, om̐ smarāya namaḥ, yan ahyas.

hana brata, taṅgal piṅ savlas, atikukus, ṅa, phalanya vīryasukha vīrya, drәman anulusdrәman anulun muvaṅ anulus.
hana brata, taṅgal ... muvaṅ nulus

hana brata, kadi rare, tan kinatәṅǝtakәn, pha, tan pavali-valy añjanma kita, sasarnya dadi ratu.
nihan brata, amati aghni, asisirih, 3, dina, tan pamaṅan sakalvirnya, tutug 3, dina, alabahan, tur tīrthanana, pha, hilaṅ pāpa kleśaniṅ śarīra.
hana brata, amaṅan sǝsǝḍǝp rumuhun, pituṅ tahun divasanya, bhaṭārī vastu hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, keḍәpiṅ rāt.
hana brata, maṅan mevak uyah harәṅ, pha, keḍәp riṅ rāt, kineriṅan deniṅ bhuvana, kinajrihan deniṅkinajrihaniṅ śatru.
hana brata, mamaṅan caturvarṇa, limaṅ vәṅi lavasanya, prajña śakti phalanika, tәhǝr kinasihaniṅ rāt, apūrva kita, sakabdhu ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

hana brata maṅan rahinariyana, 5, tәluṅ lek lavasnya, pha, halus jarijinta, mvaṅni romantaromanira.

hana brata, ṅantara, ṅa, maṅan tәṅah ṅve, tәṅah vәṅi, tigaṅ lek lavasnya mabhyāsa, pha, śakti saturasta, sukha magə̄ṅ.
hana brata, maṅan pituṅ kәpǝl, sadina, pituṅ rahina samayanya, mabrata, catur ṅaraniṅ brata, pha, riṅ dadi vvaṅ sarvavәsi tan tumamahi śarīranta, riṅ niṣkala.

hana brata, yan amaṅan tan paluṅguh, saṅ hyaṅ hayu maveh brata, saṅ hyaṅ laku-laku haraniṅ brata, ya pinakarūpa hayu raspati, pha, sukha riṅ lakunta, lәbur tampakta aśrī iṅiriṅan, deniṅ pavoṅan, siddhaniṅ vvaṅ sukha sugih, amukti sāriniṅ kaḍaton, kita riṅ dlāha.

hana brata, amaṇḍapaamadhapa, ṅa, amaṅan riṅ paṅkon, malamak patra, saṅ hyaṅ sūkṣma maveh brata, phalanya sapolahta pantǝs, tan pәgat sihniṅ malaky arabi, salek samayanya, ma, om̐ sūkṣmāya namaḥ, pamit.
hana brata, tan pamaṅan sarvāmbǝkan, naṅkǝn pon, mvaṅ kalivon, pha, keḍәpiṅ rāt.
hana brata, yan amaṅan aṅilo riṅ pahesan, naṅkǝn pūrṇama, satahun divasanya, pha, mañjanma riṅ kabayan buyut sugih.

nihan aji rambut, amaṅan sәga hirәṅ, naṅkǝn caturthi, śukla pakṣa, ma, hulun aṅaji rambut, tan abaṅ, tan hana raṅraṅ, tan hana putih, sәlǝm abuluniṅ gagak, adavā, alәmәsalambas, atәtәl, konṅkon rambutin hulun, katәmu maṅko, lәvih kaṅ tǝmbe hulun aṅaji rambut, vastu hulun aṅaji rambut, om̐ sa ba ta a i namā śivāya.
hana brata, mona mūjā, pha, deva masih iri kita.

hana brata, mona, ṅa, yan aṅisiṅ, yan ahuyuh, yan adyus, yan alәlәṅa, yan abasahan, yan lumaku, pituṅ lek samayanya, bhaṭāra śiva maveh brata, sasarnya sugih duve, sugih vәka, tur keḍәp, mañjanma riṅ mantrī.

div.p: i śaka, 1722. vai, ka, vrә, vāra marakihmrakih, pratipāda riṅ śukla pakṣa, asuji maśa, rah, 2, tǝṅgǝk, 2. i rika divasanya, pūrṇa linikhita.
Om̐. Let there be no obstacle.

This is the Right Behaviour According to the context of this passage, which explains the right behaviour when performing an observance, such as asking permission from the one who in charge in observance, offering betel leaves and reciting mantras, I have chosen parikramaning ‘proper order of things, right behaviour, customs (ritual) sanctioned by tradition’ (OJED, s.v.), as attested in mss. N and M. This is instead of panarima, probably a non-standard form of panariman ‘he who is given st., recipient’ (OJED, s.v.) as attested in mss. G and P, or tiṅkahiṅ panarima, meaning ‘way of acting for the recipient’ (the meaning of the word tiṅkah in OJED s.v.) as attested in ms. U. The words parikrama, panarima and tiṅkahiṅ panarima in Old Javanese have similar meanings. In the context of observance, the word parikramaniṅ brata emphasises the process of systematic conduct when performing the observance. Conversely, the word panarima brata and tiṅkahiṅ panarima brata emphasises the preparation of the practitioner before performing the observance.
in [Performing] Observances. When you perform an observance, do not do it haphazardly, without having permission to the one who is in charge of the observances, [namely] the reverend KakiThe word kaki means ‘grandfather; old man, elder; venerable’ (OJED, s.v.). CitragoptaCitragopta or Citragupta is the keeper of the records of the good and evil deeds of human beings for Yama, and as such is well-known both from Skt. and OJ. literature (his name is also given as Citragotra. In Balinese tradition, he has a famous name as Saṅ Surātma). In Kakavin Śivarātrikalpa as already mentioned by Teeuw et al. (1969: 52) he reads a book with full account of one’s deed during one’s life. In India the book is called Agrasandhāni; in the Kakavin Śivarātrikalpa it is called a galih, but no specific name is given. [and] NiniThe word nini means ‘grandmother; woman (used in designating or addressing a religious person or an unmarried princess or girl of noble birth)’ (OJED, s.v.). Citragopta The portrayal of the figure of Nini Citragopta as a female deity alongside Kaki Citragopta prior to the performance of observance in this text is particularly intriguing, as no mention of Nini Citragopta is to be found in the corpus of Old Javanese and Balinese literature. The presence of this figure brings to mind the concept of śakti in Śaivism. This is one of the key elements indicating the presence of a tantric spirit within this text..
[The request] should be received [by means of] an offeringI have chosen to use the word caru rather than the abbreviation ca as the abbreviation because it is not commonly found in the corpus of Old Javanese literature. Furthermore, by using the word caru, which means ‘to have (make, present) as an offering’ (OJED, s.v.), will help readers to understand the meaning of the term directly. of a white and green betel leaf on a well. The mantra is: “My Lord Kaki Citragopta and Nini Citragopta, I ask permission to perform an observance. My Lord, please accompany me when I perform an observance! Everything that I strive after, let it be obtained! If I make a mistake when performing an observance, let it be blamed on the reverend one who is in charge of the observances!” All your observances [will then be] like that.By asking permission to the Kaki Citragopta and Nini Citragopta, practitioners of the observance simultaneously seek protection from them. If they commit a mistake, that mistake is attributed to this deity. This appears to be a tactic employed by practitioners to ensure their safety while performing the observance.
Further, the teeth-polishing leaves [have to be used] by the one who carries out the observances. The exceedingly good one is the hambuluHambulu, ambulu is a particular kind of tree, of the ficus family (Jb.: Ficus infectoria) (OJED, s.v.).; the result is [to become] rich in gold.
There are the teeth-polishing leaves of the kayәn Kayәn is a particular kind of tree and its flowers. In bal. com. used to render kuyaṅ, q.v. (OJED, s.v.).; the result is many children.
There are the teeth-polishing leaves of the vaṅkal Vaṅkal is a particular kind of (wild) tree (KBW: a variety of mimosa) (OJED, s.v.).; the result is [to become] rich in rice.
There are the teeth-polishing leaves of the lampәni Lampәni is a shrub plant that is about two meters high, the leaves are oval in shape, the young fruit tastes sour, while the old ones taste sweet and are dark red; (KBI, 2016: 717).; the result is that you are successful. The dosage of all the mixtures are the same. It is appropriate to pay full attention to it.

This is the Holy Scripture The word tattva derived from Sanskrit has many meanings. The OJED defines it as ‘what something is in fact; the facts of the matter; how it really happened; the true story; the essential; the actual; the various categories of reality according to Sāmkhya doctrine; the doctrine concerning reality; the philosophy; the writings containing this doctrine; and really or in reality’ (OJED, s.v.). In this context, I have translated the word tattva as ‘holy scripture’, equating it with dharma and jñāna in Old Javanese. Acri (2018: 9) has provided a detailed explanation of the meaning of tattva and jñāna as ‘scripture’ in Old Javanese and Sanskrit sources to support this argument. on the Observances.
Perfection in observances, its reality is bodiless. The Holy Dharma, its reality is [like] bars of hedge, for it serves as the tie with the reality of the observances [which keeps them together], and [it] also releases supernatural power.This passage discusses the relationship between brata ‘the observance’ and dharma ‘the truth’. The text explains that the reality of perfection in observances is bodiless. This is why it needs the holy truth as its body to hold everything together. Metaphorically, the truth is referred to as ‘the bars of a hedge’. Here, the metaphor ‘bars of hedge’ indicates that the truth acts as a ‘barrier’ to ensure that, after obtaining supernatural power, the practitioner of the observance still behaves in daily life under the light of Dharma and uses his supernatural power for kindness.
They (i.e., the observances and the Dharma) are just like the left and right bodies. The left body refers to the ‘observances‘ (brata), and the right body refers to the ‘holy truth‘ (dharma). The two concepts complement each other
The reality of observances and asceticism is likewise.There are two interpretations regarding the use of the word tapa here. Firstly, the word tapa may be used in parallel with the word dharma ‘holy truth’, as explained in the previous sentence. Secondly, the word tapa is actually used in conjunction with the word brata ‘observance’. OJED (s.v.) explains that the word tapa means ‘religious austerity, bodily mortification, penance, asceticism’. Often in combination with brata, either ‘the observance of asceticism (penance)’ or ‘penance and other religious observances’.
That is why, one who strives to obtain goodness should perform [observances and asceticism]. [If] young people perform observances, they will obtain the result of them at a young age. There is nothing that comes into being unless it is performed; there is nothing to be taken from the arrangement [according to] what has been arranged.
As if one cooks rice in the morning and eats it that morning, one cooks rice at noon and eats it that noon, one cooks rice in the evening and eats in that evening. If one is not cooking, one is not eating. [The conclusion is that] the results are according to one’s conduct.
Such is the right order of [actions and results]. Because the result of bad and good conduct is obtained, that is why good conduct should be performed without delay. [This] originates from the Holy Scripture on Observances.
This is The Detailed Enumeration of the Observances. It should be known.

There is the observance of ‘Cutting Off the Taste’ (Mәgat Rasa): if one eats half [portion], and stands up
The literal meaning of the word sumĕṅka is ‘to go upwards, rise, climb’ (OJED s.v.). In this passage, I have translated it more liberal as ‘stand up’.
for chewing betel. It is fine if one does not speak. After chewing betel, one can eat again. Its appointed duration is one year. The deity is the Goddess Umā. The mantra is: “Om̐ Mam̐ hail to Umā!”. [I take] leave. Its result is that the love of husband and wife is not cut off, and all people love [you].

There is the observance of eating rice from slaṅgiI have chosen the word slaṅgi as attested in ms. U in the Balinese, which means ‘a pyramid-shaped structure made of aren palm or jackfruit leaves used to display rice during the Kuningan festival’ (KBI, 2016: 987). I have not found the meaning of the word ṅgi attested in ms. G and N, as well as the word ṅgi as attested in ms. M, nor of gaṅgi as attested in ms. P.
Its duration is seven months. The deity is the Goddess Vastu. The mantra is: “Om̐ hail to the Goddess Vastu!” [I take ] leave. Its result is that the love of husband and wife is not cut off, and all peopleI have emended the phrase sama janma attested in G M N U and janma kabeh attested in P to samanta janma ‘all people’. I made this decision in the light of previous passage 3.1 mvaṅ samanta janma paḍa sih ‘and all people love [you]’. love you and feel sympathy for you.

There is the observance of the ‘Earth-Plate’ (Bhūmipattra)The name of this brata is the same as that in passage 3.50, but it differs in terms of the technical details of its performance, the deity involved, and the result.: if one eats without using plates, and lays [the food] openly on earth. The deity is reverend Vaiśravaṇa. Its appointed duration is one year and seven months. The mantra is: “Om̐ hail to the illustrious I have chosen the word śrī, which is attested in P, instead of Śram̐ in G, Sam̐ in M and N, and Śi in U. This is because in other passages of this text, such as 3.7 om̐ śrī ratih devyai namaḥ, 3.10 om̐ śrī smarāya namaḥ, 3.11 om̐ śrī śrī devyai namaḥ, etc., the word śrī is used instead of the other bījamantra. The bījamantras like śram̐ in G, sam̐ in M and N, and śi are not appropriate in this context. In the Indian tradition, the reverend Vaiśravaṇa is often identified with Kubera. He is the guardian of the northern direction and his home is in the northern quadrant of the topmost tier of the lower half of Mount Meru. Vaiśravaṇa!” [I take ] leave. Its result is being rich in land and freeholds, and you are loved by the king and priests.

There is the observance of ‘Craving to Embroider’ (Anulam Iḍam)I have conjectured nulam idhan in G, nulam iḍam in M, N and U, and nulambhi nan in P to anulam iḍam ‘craving to embroider’. This word has been conjectured to convey the proper meaning in Old Javanese. The word anulam is derived from the word sulam, meaning ‘to embroider’ (OJED s.v.), and the word iḍam means ‘to experience the cravings of pregnancy, to be pregnant’ (OJED s.v.). Thus, the word anulam iḍam can be translated as ‘craving to embroider’. : one fast all day, until the end of the day. Its appointed duration is three months. Its result is that all desires will be obtained quickly because of that. You will be beloved by men. The deity is the Reverend Brahmā. Mantra: “Om̐ Am̐ hail to Brahmā!” [I take] leave.

There is the observance of eating before the Reverend Sun goes down. Its appointed duration is three years. The deity of the observance is the Lord Śiva. Its result is that the mind will be clear. Your thoughts are alive In this context, the phrase ‘thought will be alive’ refers to a state of mind full of inspiration. It is also suitable with the technique of the observance that has a link to the Reverend Sun as the origin of all light in this world, and is also in accordance with the belief that the Reverend Sun is the origin of all light in this world. in one goal. Mantra: “Om̐ Mam̐ hail to Śiva!” If you apply make up.

There is the observance of not eating when the Reverend Sun is already at sunset. Its appointed duration is one year. The deity is the Reverend Śiva. The mantra is: “Om̐, hail to Śiva!” [I take] leave. Its result is that one will be knowledgeable in every kind of work, especially in learning; and one will not be ignorant in playing the gamәlan Gamәlan is percussion instrument, ensemble of percussion instruments (OJED, s.v.). , telling a story, and [composing] kakavin Kakavin is poem (in Indian metres) (OJED, s.v.).; one will be handsome without equal.

There is the observance of ‘Full Moon’ (Amūrṇama): you are fasting every full moon. Its appointed duration is seven years and seven months. The deity is the Goddess Ratih. Mantra: “Om̐ hail to Śrī Ratih!” [I take] leave. Its result is that your work will be successful, God and Demon will love you.

There is the observance of ‘Dark Moon’ (Nilәm): you are fasting every dark moon. Its appointed duration is seven months. The deity is the Goddess Rātri Devi. The mantra is: “Om̐ hail to Rātri Devi!” [I take] leave. Its result is that you will be loved by mankind; God and Demon will love you.

There is the observance of ‘the Abundance’ In the light of Sanskrit (Monier-Williams, 1182), I translate the name of this observance, Narasvatī, as ‘the abundance’ instead of ‘acting like Sarasvatī’, due to the absence of a link between Sarasvatī, the goddess of knowledge, and the deity and mantra in this observance. According to the deity of this passage, Rāja Lakṣmi, who is revered as the goddess of happiness, fortune, wealth, prosperity, beauty, fertility, sovereignty and abundance, this translation is appropriate. (Narasvatī): one does not eat the cooked rice [that is cooked with] abundant water. It is only the rice cone without meat, just salt. Its appointed duration is one year and seven months. The deity is Goddess Rāja Lakṣmi. The mantra is: “Om̐ hail to Śri Rāja Lakṣmi!” [I take] leave. Its result is that your good qualities will come out, and all your aims will be fulfilled, and then you will be famous, and you will be in harmony with your spouse.

There is the observance of ‘Always in Bloom’ Other posibility to translate this term are ‘always worshiping with flowers’, ‘always arranging flowers’, and ‘always wearing flowers’. (Muṣpasadā): when one should eat the flower as meat first. Its appointed duration is one year. The deity is Reverend Smara. The mantra is: “Om̐ hail to Smara!” [I take] leave. Its result is that one’s face is matchless; many [people] will love you deeply.

There is the observance of ‘Applying Salve’ (Ṅlepana): when one eats the side dishIn Modern Javanese, the word lalab refers to ‘uncooked fruit and leaves eaten with rice’ (OJED, s.v.), whereas in Balinese, it refers to ‘boiled food’ (KBI, 2016: 290). as meat first.
